## Multi-Omics Overview

```{r}
multi_omics_names <- names(experiments(multi_omics_full))

multi_omics_selected <- multi_omics_names[grepl("WGB|RNA|Untargeted|Metallomics|Histone|Shotgun.*Genus",
                                                multi_omics_names)]
multi_omics_selected
```

```{r}
multi_omics <- multi_omics_full
filtered_exps <- lapply(names(multi_omics_full), function(multi_omics_names){
    multi_omics_exp <- experiments(multi_omics_full)[[multi_omics_names]]
    p_val_dt <- rowData(multi_omics_exp)[,grepl("adj.p.value", colnames(rowData(multi_omics_exp)))]
    p_val_dt <- p_val_dt[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt))]
    multi_omics_exp <- multi_omics_exp[apply(as.matrix(p_val_dt) <= 0.05, 1, any),]
    
    # if(nrow(multi_omics_exp) == 0){return(NA)}
    
    multi_omics_exp
})
names(filtered_exps) <- names(multi_omics)
filtered_exps[is.na(filtered_exps)] <- NULL

experiments(multi_omics) <- ExperimentList(filtered_exps)
multi_omics_selected <- multi_omics_selected[multi_omics_selected %in% names(multi_omics)]
```

```{r}
multi_omics_ordered <- names(multi_omics)[c(16, 41, 13, 40, 38, 14, 
                                            39, 37, 15, 5, 11, 19, 25, 
                                            29, 33, 30, 34, 32, 36, 31, 35)]

omic_names_dict <- c("Liver RNA Sequencing", "Liver DNA Methylation",

                    "Liver Untargeted Metabolomics",

                    "Serum Targeted Metabolomics",

                    paste(rep(c("Cecum","Colon"), 3),

                          "Pathways", "Pathways"))
                    )

group_color_dict <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(levels(droplevels(multi_omics$group))),
```

```{r}
omic_names_dup <- sapply(strsplit(multi_omics_ordered, "\\."), 
                        function(x){x[[1]]})
omic_names_dup[grep("cogs", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "cogs"
omic_names_dup[grep("EC", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "EC"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_kegg", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_kegg"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_pathway", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_pathway"

names(omic_names_dup) <- multi_omics_ordered

unique_omics <- unique(omic_names_dup)

omic_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(unique_omics), name = "Set3")

col_list <- lapply(seq_along(unique_omics), function(omic_id){
    omic_name <- unique_omics[omic_id]
    
    colors_found <- names(omic_names_dup)[omic_names_dup == omic_name]
    
    omic_num <- length(colors_found)
    omic_col <- omic_colors[omic_id]
    
    col_ramp <- colorRampPalette(colors = c(omic_col, "white"))(omic_num + 1)[seq_len(omic_num)]
    names(col_ramp) <- colors_found
    return(col_ramp)
})

color_vect <- unlist(col_list)
omic_color_dict <- color_vect


set2_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "Paired")
plot(1:length(set2_colors), 1:length(set2_colors), col = set2_colors, pch = 19)

omic_color_dict["Metallomics.liver"] <- set2_colors[7]
omic_color_dict["Shotgun_Metagenomics_Functional.colon.cogs"] <- set2_colors[4]
```

```{r}
group_var <- "group"

plot_dt <- lapply(names(experiments(selected_exps)), function(omic_name){
    omic_cd <- data.frame("sample_name" = colnames(experiments(selected_exps)[[omic_name]]))
    omic_cd$var_name <- omic_name
    omic_cd$value <- 1
    omic_cd

plot_dt <- do.call(rbind, plot_dt)
plot_dt$sample_name <- factor(plot_dt$sample_name)

group_var_dict <- colData(multi_omics)[[group_var]]
names(group_var_dict) <- colData(multi_omics)[[sample_var]]

sample_levels <- levels(plot_dt$sample_name)
reordered_sample_levels <- sample_levels[order(group_var_dict[as.character(sample_levels)])]

                               levels = reordered_sample_levels)

x_colors <- group_color_dict[as.character(group_var_dict[levels(plot_dt$sample_name)])]

if(!dir.exists(fig_dir)){dir.create(fig_dir)}
```

```{r}
lapply(unique(plot_dt_lab$var_id), function(omic_id){
    svg(paste0("../../outputs/Paper_Figures/Figure_1_pie_", omic_id, ".svg"))
    
    plot_dt_var <- plot_dt_lab[plot_dt_lab$var_id == omic_id,]
    pie_dt <- data.frame("var_id" = plot_dt_var$var_id, 
                        "values" = c(plot_dt_var$num_vars, 
                                    plot_dt_var$num_vars_raw - plot_dt_var$num_vars),
                        "Significant" = c("Significant", "Not significant"))
    
    p <- ggplot(pie_dt, aes(x="", y= values, fill=Significant)) +
        geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, color="white") +
        coord_polar("y", start=0) + theme_void() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("Significant" = "blue4",
                                     "Not significant" = "white"))
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    return(NULL)
})
```

## Enrich information

```{r}
# omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
# ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", "entrezID", "geneId")

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", 
                 "RNA_Sequencing", 
                 "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", 
                      "entrezID", "geneId")
omic_dt <- multi_omics_full

library(SummarizedExperiment)

## Enrich IDs dictionary
omic_dict_list <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
    
    omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
    omic_dict <- strsplit(rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]], ";")
    
    names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
    
    omic_dict
    
}, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)

omic_rd <- lapply(experiments(omic_dt)[omic_enrich], rowData)
num_factors <- 2
## Universe IDs mapped
universe_list_ids <- lapply(names(omic_rd), function(omic_name){
    omic_ids <- omic_dict_list[[omic_name]][paste0(omic_name, ".", rownames(omic_rd[[omic_name]]))]
    omic_ids <- omic_ids[!is.null(omic_ids)]
    omic_ids <- unlist(omic_ids)
    omic_ids[!is.na(omic_ids)]

})
names(universe_list_ids) <- names(omic_rd)
```

```{r}
## ORA IDs
clu_ids_enrich <- lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    omic_names <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "WGB_DNA_Methylation", "RNA_Sequencing")
    clu_ids <- lapply(omic_names, function(omic_id){
        omic_exp <- experiments(omic_dt)[[omic_id]]
        features_factor <- rownames(rowData(omic_exp))[rowData(omic_exp)[[paste0("Factor_", 
                                                            factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]]
        paste0(omic_id, ".", features_factor)
    })
    names(clu_ids) <- omic_names
    
    metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][clu_ids$Untargeted_Metabolomics]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]

    wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][clu_ids$WGB_DNA_Methylation]
    wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]
    
    rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][clu_ids$RNA_Sequencing]
    rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]
    
    return(list(
        "Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt,
        "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt, 
        "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt))
})
names(clu_ids_enrich) <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))
```

```{r}
## GSEA FCs
col_names <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics",
                "RNA_Sequencing",
                "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged",
                      "entrezID", "geneId")

fc_dict <- lapply(col_names, function(col_name){
    col_name <- paste0(col_name, "_weights")
    # 
    omic_fc_dict <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
        omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
        omic_dict <- rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]]
        
        fc_dt <- rowData(omic_data)[[col_name]]
        
        names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
        
        omic_fc <- mapply(function(var_names, fc_vect){
            var_names_split <- strsplit(var_names, ";")[[1]]
            var_names_split <- var_names_split[!is.na(var_names_split)]
            if(!length(var_names_split)){return(NULL)}
            fc_vect_dict <- rep(fc_vect, length(var_names_split))
            names(fc_vect_dict) <- var_names_split
            fc_vect_dict
        }, var_names = omic_dict, fc_vect = fc_dt, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
        
        unlist(omic_fc)
    }, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)
    
    omic_fc_dict
})
names(fc_dict) <- col_names
```

```{r}
mice_dt <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(params$input_dir, "AnimalData_OscarYanes.xlsx"))
# mice_num <- mice_dt[,c("BW(g)", "WATep(g)", "Liver(g)")]
mice_num <- mice_dt
mice_s <- as.data.frame(mice_num)
dict_vect <- c("Ctrl" = "CNT", "Ctrl ext" = "CNT", "HFD" = "HFD",
               "INT2" = "INT", "HFD excl." = "HFE")
mice_s$group <- factor(dict_vect[mice_dt$Group], levels = c("CNT", "HFD", 
                                                            "INT", "HFE"))
dict_vect_g <- c("CNT" = "C", "HFD" = "H", "INT" = "I", "HFE" = "E")
mice_s$samplename <- paste0(make.names(mice_dt$ID), dict_vect_g[mice_s$group])
mice_s$samplename[mice_s$samplename == "X686I"] <- "X687I"
mice_s$Sacrifice <- as.factor(mice_s$Sacrifice)

mice_found <- mice_s[match(colnames(dt_exp), mice_s$samplename),]
rownames(mice_found) <- mice_found$samplename

mice_all <- mice_dt[match(rownames(colData(multi_omics_raw)), mice_dt$samplename),]
```

## Gene analysis

```{r}
exp_id <- "RNA_Sequencing"

dt_exp <- multi_omics[[exp_id]]
dt_exp_raw <- multi_omics_raw[[exp_id]]
dt_exp_raw <- dt_exp_raw[,dt_exp_raw$group != "HFE"]
```

```{r}
p_val_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp)[,grepl("adj.p.value",
                                colnames(rowData(dt_exp)))]
p_val_dt_g <- p_val_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt_g))]

fc_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp)[,grepl("FC",
                                colnames(rowData(dt_exp)))]
fc_dt_g <- fc_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(fc_dt_g))]

p_val_sum <- lapply(p_val_dt_g, function(x){
    sum(x <= 0.05)
})

fc_dir <- lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    fc_dir <- ifelse(sig_vars <= 0, "Down-regulated", "Up-regulated")
    table(fc_dir)
})
names(fc_dir) <- names(fc_dt_g)
fc_dir

fc_dir


lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    summary(abs(sig_vars))
})


comp_dt <- lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    summary(sig_vars)
    data.frame("fc" = sig_vars, "comparison" = names(fc_dt_g)[[x_id]])
})
comp_dt <- do.call(rbind, comp_dt)
ggplot(comp_dt) + geom_histogram(aes(x = abs(fc), fill = comparison), bins = 60) +
    theme_minimal()

tapply(abs(comp_dt$fc), INDEX = comp_dt$comparison, summary)



```

```{r}
## Variable variance tests
library(DESeq2)
dt_exp_raw_DESeq <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = assay(dt_exp_raw),
                                      colData = colData(dt_exp_raw),
                                      design= ~ 0 + group)
dt_exp_raw_DESeq <- estimateSizeFactors(dt_exp_raw_DESeq)
normalized_counts <- counts(dt_exp_raw_DESeq, normalized = TRUE)

## Without filtering
group_sds <- lapply(levels(dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group), function(x){
    group_dt <- normalized_counts[,dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group == x]
    data.frame("sd" = rowSds(as.matrix(assay(group_dt))), "group" = x)
})
group_sds <- do.call(rbind, group_sds)

ggplot(group_sds) + geom_density(aes(x = log(sd), fill = group))

tapply(X = group_sds$sd, INDEX = group_sds$group, FUN = summary)

kruskal.test(formula = sd ~ group, data = group_sds)
DescTools::ConoverTest(x = group_sds$sd, g = group_sds$group, 
                        method = "fdr", alternative = "two.sided")

# conover.test::conover.test(x = group_sds$sd, g = group_sds$group)

## With filtering
p_val_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp_raw)[,grepl("adj.p.value",
                                        colnames(rowData(dt_exp_raw)))]
p_val_dt_g <- p_val_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt_g))]
normalized_counts_f <- normalized_counts[apply(as.matrix(p_val_dt_g) <= 0.05, 1, any),]

group_sds_f <- lapply(levels(dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group), function(x){
    group_dt <- normalized_counts_f[,dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group == x]
    data.frame("sd" = rowSds(as.matrix(assay(group_dt))), "group" = x)
})
group_sds_f <- do.call(rbind, group_sds_f)

ggplot(group_sds_f) + geom_density(aes(x = sd, fill = group))
ggplot(group_sds_f) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = group, y = log(sd)))

kruskal.test(formula = sd ~ group, data = group_sds_f)
DescTools::ConoverTest(x = group_sds_f$sd, g = group_sds_f$group, 
                        method = "fdr", alternative = "two.sided")

summary(aov(formula = log(sd) ~ group, data = group_sds_f))
TukeyHSD(aov(formula = log(sd) ~ group, data = group_sds_f))

# conover.test::conover.test(x = group_sds_f$sd, g = group_sds_f$group, 
#                            method = "bh", altp = T)
```

```{r}

hermes_kegg_filt <- sapply(strsplit(rowData(multi_omics@ExperimentList$Untargeted_Metabolomics)$PutativeMetabolitesKEGG, "/|;"), function(x){
    paste0(x[x != "NA" & !is.na(x)], collapse = " / ")

putative_metabolites_readable <- sapply(strsplit(rowData(multi_omics@ExperimentList$Untargeted_Metabolomics)$PutativeMetabolites, "/|;"), function(x){
    paste0(x[x != "NA" & !is.na(x)], collapse = " / ")
})
putative_metabolites_readable[putative_metabolites_readable == ""] <- NA


compounds_merged_readable <- rowData(multi_omics@ExperimentList$Untargeted_Metabolomics)$compound_names
```

```{r}
pdf(paste0(plot_output_dir, "compositions_shotgun.pdf"))

lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]

    ## Abundance plots
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts", 
                                method = "relabundance")
    
    # Getting top taxa on a Phylum level
    top_taxa <- getTopFeatures(hierarchy, top = 10, assay.type = "relabundance")
    
    # Renaming the "Phylum" rank to keep only top taxa and the rest to "Other"
    cat_renamed <- lapply(rownames(hierarchy),
                       function(x){if (x %in% top_taxa) {x} else {"Other"}})
    rowData(hierarchy)[[hierarchy_name]] <- as.character(cat_renamed)
    
    # Visualizing the composition barplot, with samples order by "Bacteroidetes"
    plotAbundance(hierarchy, assay.type= "relabundance", rank = hierarchy_name,
                  order_rank_by="abund", 
                  order_sample_by = "group",  add_x_text = TRUE) + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
## Composition sepparated
pdf(paste0(plot_output_dir, "compositions_sep_shotgun.pdf"))

lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    ## Abundance plots
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts", 
                                method = "relabundance")
    if(nrow(hierarchy) == 0){return(NULL)}
    # Getting top taxa on a Phylum level
    top_taxa <- getTopFeatures(hierarchy, top = min(nrow(hierarchy), 10), 
                                assay.type = "relabundance")
    
    # Renaming the "Phylum" rank to keep only top taxa and the rest to "Other"
    cat_renamed <- lapply(rownames(hierarchy),
                       function(x){if (x %in% top_taxa) {x} else {"Other"}})
    rowData(hierarchy)[[hierarchy_name]] <- as.character(cat_renamed)
    
    # Visualizing the composition barplot, with samples order by "Bacteroidetes"
    plotAbundance(hierarchy, assay.type= "relabundance", rank = hierarchy_name,
                  order_rank_by="abund", 
                  order_sample_by = "group",  add_x_text = TRUE) + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) 
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(mia)

lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]
    
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts",
                                method = "clr", pseudocount = 1)
    
    # Run MDS on clr assay with Aitchison distance
    p1 <- data_pca(dt_list = t(scale(t(assay(hierarchy)))), 
                    metadata = colData(hierarchy),
                    stratificationVar = "group", plot_name = hierarchy_id,
                    color_vect = group_color_dict) + theme_minimal()
    p1
})
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]
    
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts",
                                method = "clr", pseudocount = 1)
    
    tse2 <- adonis(data = colData(hierarchy), assay.type = "clr",
                    formula = t(assay(hierarchy)) ~ group,
                    method = "euclidean", na.action = na.exclude)
    
    tse2$aov.tab
})
```

```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height = 3}
metal_order <- c("V", "Fe", "Cu", "Zn", "As", "Mn", "Se", "Co", "Mg", "Cd",
                 "Al", "Cr", "Pb", "Ni")
library(ggpubr)
p_list <- lapply(metal_order, function(metal_id){
    metal_filt <- metal_plot_bp[metal_plot_bp$metal == metal_id,]
    metal_filt$region_f <- factor(metal_filt$region, 
                                levels = c("Metallomics.cecum", "Metallomics.liver"), 
                                labels = c("Gut", "Liver"))
    metal_filt$group <- droplevels(metal_filt$group)
    
    diet_metals_filt <- diet_metals_plot_2[diet_metals_plot_2$metal == metal_id,]
    diet_metals_filt$region_f <- factor(diet_metals_filt$region, 
                                levels = c("Metallomics.cecum", "Metallomics.liver"), 
                                labels = c("Gut", "Liver"))
    diet_metals_filt$group <- factor(diet_metals_filt$group, 
                                     levels = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT"), 
                                     labels = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT"))
    
    p1 <- ggplot(metal_filt, aes(x = group, y = Intensity, fill = group))  + 
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2, box.linewidth = 0.1, 
                     whisker.linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) + 
        geom_line(data = diet_metals_filt, 
                aes(x = group, y = mean, group = metal), color = "gray",
                alpha = 1) +
        geom_point(data = diet_metals_filt, shape = 23, size = 2,
                aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group), color = "black",
                alpha = 1) +
        ggh4x::facet_grid2(cols = vars(region_f)) +
        stat_pwc(mapping = aes(x = group, y = Intensity), data= metal_filt,
                 label.size = 3, label = "p.signif", 
                 p.adjust.method = "fdr") + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(
            plot.margin = unit(c(1.2,0.4,0.4,0.4), "lines"), 
            axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
            axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict) + 
        scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x){format(x, scientific = TRUE)}) 
    p1    
})

ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "Supp_Figure_X_Metal_Legend.svg"), 
        plot = p_list[[2]], dpi = 300, fix_text_size = FALSE, width = 2, height = 2)
```

```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height = 3}
    diet_metals_filt <- diet_metals_plot_2[diet_metals_plot_2$metal == metal_id,]
    diet_metals_filt$region_f <- factor(diet_metals_filt$region, 
                                levels = c("Metallomics.cecum", "Metallomics.liver"), 
                                labels = c("Gut", "Liver"))
    diet_metals_filt$group <- factor(diet_metals_filt$group,
                                     levels = c("CVM", "GFM"),
                                     labels = c("CV", "GF"))

    p1 <- ggplot(metal_filt, aes(x = group, y = Intensity, fill = group))  + 
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2, box.linewidth = 0.1, 
                     whisker.linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) + 
        geom_line(data = diet_metals_filt, 
                aes(x = group, y = mean, group = metal), color = "gray",
                alpha = 1) +
        geom_point(data = diet_metals_filt, shape = 23, size = 2,
                aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group), color = "black",
                alpha = 1) + 
        ggh4x::facet_grid2(cols = vars(region_f)) + 
        stat_pwc(mapping = aes(x = group, y = Intensity), data= metal_filt,
             label.size = 2) +
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(
            plot.margin = unit(c(1.2,0.4,0.4,0.4), "lines"), 
            axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
            axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict_gfcv) + 
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(c(diet_metals_filt$mean,
                                            metal_filt$Intensity))),
                           labels = function(x){format(x, scientific = TRUE)})
        
    p1 <- ggplot(metal_filt, aes(x = group, y = Intensity, fill = group))  + 
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2, box.linewidth = 0.1, 
                     whisker.linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) + 
        geom_line(data = diet_metals_filt, 
                aes(x = group, y = mean, group = metal), color = "gray",
                alpha = 1) +
        geom_point(data = diet_metals_filt, shape = 23, size = 2,
                aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group), color = "black",
                alpha = 1) + 
        ggh4x::facet_grid2(cols = vars(region_f)) + 
        stat_pwc(mapping = aes(x = group, y = Intensity), data= metal_filt,
             label.size = 3, label = "p.signif", 
             p.adjust.method = "fdr") +
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(
            plot.margin = unit(c(1.2,0.4,0.4,0.4), "lines"), 
            axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
            axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict_gfcv) + 
        scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x){format(x, scientific = TRUE)})
    
    
    p1    
})
```

## Run MOFA2

We have a multi-omic dataset with over 35 datasets, including the different levels of hierarchy for the 16S and Shotgun Metagenomics and the different annotations for the functional metagenomics results.

We visualized the principal component analysis for each individual omic to have a vision of the data and select which datasets from the hierarchical levels and the functional metagenomics. With the results we choose to keep the Species hierarchy level and for the functional metagenomics the COGS and metaerg-kegg annotations.

We also applied a p-value threshold of 0.05 in any of the contrast to filter variables and match the results from the whole genome bisulphite that, because we used the DSS method that finds DMRs from clusters of statistically significant CpGs were already biased.

Thus, the MOFA model will help us find correlated feature patterns in the statistically significant data.

```{r}
param_list <- list(input_dir = "../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/",
    output_dir = "../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/MOFA_Results/",
    multi_omics_exp = multi_omics[,colData(multi_omics)$group != "HFE", rev(sel_multi_omics_mofa)],
    group_var = "group",
    num_factors = 2,
    results_name = mofa_dir_name,
    color_vec = group_color_dict, 
    score_filter = score_filter)
xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render,
                    args = list(input = "./MOFA_Models.Rmd", 
                                output_file = paste0(param_list$output_dir,
                                                     param_list$results_name, ".html"), 
                                params = param_list
                            )
                    )
```




We can look at the resulting html file and we can the that all most of the variance for all the omics data is captured by the two first factors and the third one is biased towards the RNA-Seq. This makes sense because we have big differences in variable size between all the omics, this phenomena is difficult to avoid because we have many omics with very low values, even if we didn't apply a filter, thus, as the first two factors, surprisingly don't seem to be affected by this effect, and we have all the omics represented at least with a 20% of explained variance in these, we decided to proceed with it.

The factor boxplots show quite clearly two different patterns in the data, the first factor, represents features which change by the high fat diet (HFD) and are restored to similar levels by the intervention (INT); the second one shows features that are affected by HFD but the intervention fails to restore to control levels, keeping their levels changed.

Correlating these factors with the explained variance of each omic, we can see many omics biased towards one of both factors thus, we can propose that the liver histone hodifications, metallomics, targeted metabolomics and methylomics (WGB); serum targeted metabolomics and the cecum and colon functional metagenomics KEGG have a higher variance explained in the first factor thus, are the omics with the most significant features that are restored by the intervention and the cecum metallomics and targeted metabolomics are biased toward the second factor, thus they are changed by the HFD and kept mostly unchanged by the intervention.

These correlations with the first factor correlation reveal that epigenetic signatures, when affected by the high fat diet, are mostly restored to control levels after a life-style intervention, and the histone modifications and targeted metabolomics, which focused on epigenetically relevant metabolites.

All the remaining omics: the liver untargeted metabolomics, rna-sequencing and the colon and cecum metagenomics and functional clusters of orthologous groups of proteins, have even weights indicating that they contain features that can explain the variance in both factors.

Interestingly most of the metagenomics data, except the kegg functions show this pattern with the transcriptomics and untargeted metabolomics.

Looking at the weights of each feature in these factors we can see which of them are most important in explaining these patterns of the data. We looked at the absolute value distribution of weights for each omic and used as threshold for variable selection a percentage of features proportional to the variance explained of each omic in each factor.

We applied an overrepresentation analysis (ORA) to the significant genes and differentially methylated regions from each weight, dividing them into three subset: all the weights and dividing it into positive and negative weights.

```{r}
ph1 <- pheatmap::pheatmap(mofa_seq_factors, 
                        show_rownames = FALSE, clustering_method = "average")


opposite_weights <- (mofa_seq_factors[,1] > 0 &
                        mofa_seq_factors[,2] < 0) | 
                        (mofa_seq_factors[,1] < 0 &
                            mofa_seq_factors[,2] > 0)

concording_weights <- !opposite_weights

f1_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[opposite_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] >= 0.6]
f2_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[opposite_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] <= 0.4]

f12_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[opposite_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] < 0.6 &
                                                mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] > 0.4]


f1_mofa_vars_extra <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[concording_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] >= 0.6]
f2_mofa_vars_extra <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[concording_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] <= 0.3]
f3_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[concording_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] < 0.6 & 
                                                mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] > 0.3]
# Divisors
# f1 > 0 / f2 < 0

# 0-0.4 Kept completely altered

# 0.4-0.5 Resistant to restoration

# 0.5-1 Completely Restored 
#####
# f1 > 0 / f2 > 0
# 0-0.3 Altered and worsened with intervention
## 0.3-0.6 Altered by the intervention only
## 0.6-0.7 Small HFD alterations high intervention changes
# 0.7-1 Changes in HFD and high intervention changes

# A partir de 0.6-0.7 ja podem assignar cada variable a un factor (0.3 millor)
# f1 > 0 / f2 < 0 -> Alteració i mantenirse 
# f1 > 0 / f2 > 0 -> Alteració petita i recuperar-se més dels CTR 

# Entre 0-0.4 del F2
```

```{r}
factor_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

library(stringr)
lapply(names(f1_multi_omics), function(omic_id){
    
    omic_rd <- rowData(f1_multi_omics[[omic_id]])
    if(omic_id == "WGB_DNA_Methylation"){
        omic_rd <- as.data.frame(rowRanges(f1_multi_omics[[omic_id]]))
    }
    
    if(omic_id == "RNA_Sequencing"){
        omic_rd <- omic_rd[,col_order]
    }
    omic_rd <- as.data.frame(omic_rd[,sapply(omic_rd, class) != "list"])

    print(omic_id)

    omic_id_short <- stringr::str_trunc(omic_id, width = 31)

                        x = omic_rd, rowNames = TRUE)
    return(NULL)
})
```

```{r}
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered.rds"))

factor_table <- lapply(col_names, function(factor_id){
    exp_table <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), function(exp_name){
        exp_dt <- experiments(omic_dt)[[exp_name]]
        factor_vars <- mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]
        factor_vars <- names(factor_vars)[names(factor_vars) %in% rownames(exp_dt)]
        table_dt <- data.frame("Freq" = length(factor_vars),
                            "Var1" = exp_name)
        
        table_dt$factor_id <- factor_id
        table_dt$omic_color <- omic_color_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)]
         
        table_dt$Var1 <- factor(omic_names_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)],
                                levels = omic_names_dict)
        table_dt
    })
    exp_table <- do.call(rbind, exp_table)
    exp_table$relFreq <- exp_table$Freq/sum(exp_table$Freq)
    exp_table
})
factor_table <- do.call(rbind, factor_table)
```

```{r}
insulin_tt_dt <- hfd_ex_dt_melt[hfd_ex_dt_melt$Test_Type == "ITT",]

connover_res <- lapply(levels(insulin_tt_dt$variable), function(point_id){
    test_dt <- insulin_tt_dt[insulin_tt_dt$variable == point_id,]
    k_test <- kruskal.test(formula = value ~ group, data = test_dt)
    con_test <- DescTools::ConoverTest(x = test_dt$value, 
                                        test_dt$group)
    list("kruskal" = k_test, "connover" = con_test)
})
names(connover_res) <- levels(insulin_tt_dt$variable)

itt_connover_merged <- lapply(c("HFD-CNT", "HFDex-CNT", "HFDex-HFD"), function(test_id){
    
    test_res <- lapply(connover_res, function(ctr_dt){
    
        as.data.frame(t(ctr_dt$connover[[1]][test_id,]))
    })
    
    test_res <- do.call(rbind, test_res)
    test_res$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(test_res$pval, "fdr")
    colnames(test_res) <- paste0(test_id, ".", colnames(test_res))
    test_res    
})
itt_connover_merged <- do.call(cbind, itt_connover_merged)

plot_dt_test_itt <- t(itt_connover_merged[,grepl("adj.p.value",colnames(itt_connover_merged))])
rownames(plot_dt_test_itt) <- gsub("\\.adj\\.p\\.value", "", rownames(plot_dt_test_itt))

colnames(plot_dt_test_itt) <- c("0 min", "15 min", "30 min", "60 min", "120 min")
```

```{r}
i_glucose_tt_dt <- hfd_ex_dt_melt[hfd_ex_dt_melt$Test_Type == "IGTT",]

connover_res <- lapply(levels(i_glucose_tt_dt$variable), function(point_id){
    test_dt <- i_glucose_tt_dt[i_glucose_tt_dt$variable == point_id,]
    k_test <- kruskal.test(formula = value ~ group, data = test_dt)
    con_test <- DescTools::ConoverTest(x = test_dt$value, 
                                        test_dt$group)
    list("kruskal" = k_test, "connover" = con_test)
})
names(connover_res) <- levels(i_glucose_tt_dt$variable)

igtt_connover_merged <- lapply(c("HFD-CNT", "HFDex-CNT", "HFDex-HFD"), function(test_id){
    
    test_res <- lapply(connover_res, function(ctr_dt){
    
        as.data.frame(t(ctr_dt$connover[[1]][test_id,]))
    })
    
    test_res <- do.call(rbind, test_res)
    test_res$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(test_res$pval, "fdr")
    colnames(test_res) <- paste0(test_id, ".", colnames(test_res))
    test_res    
})
igtt_connover_merged <- do.call(cbind, igtt_connover_merged)

plot_dt_test_igtt <- t(igtt_connover_merged[,grepl("adj.p.value",colnames(igtt_connover_merged))])
rownames(plot_dt_test_igtt) <- gsub("\\.adj\\.p\\.value", "", rownames(plot_dt_test_igtt))

colnames(plot_dt_test_igtt) <- c("0 min", "15 min", "30 min", "60 min", "120 min")

plot_dt_test_igtt_sc <- plot_dt_test_igtt

plot_dt_test_igtt_sc[plot_dt_test_igtt > 0.1] <- "ns"
plot_dt_test_igtt_sc[plot_dt_test_igtt < 0.1] <- "ns*"
plot_dt_test_igtt_sc[plot_dt_test_igtt < 0.05] <- "*"
plot_dt_test_igtt_sc[plot_dt_test_igtt < 0.01] <- "**"
plot_dt_test_igtt_sc[plot_dt_test_igtt < 0.001] <- "***"
```

```{r}
deseq_omics <- c("RNA_Sequencing", "Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus",
                 "Shotgun_Metagenomics_Functional.colon.cogs")
hfd_hfe_res_test <- lapply(names(experiments(multi_omics_raw)[sel_multi_omics_mofa]), function(exp_id){
    exp_dt <- experiments(multi_omics_raw)[[exp_id]]
    if(exp_id %in% deseq_omics){
        deseq_dt <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(assay(exp_dt)),
                                                   colData = colData(exp_dt), 
                                                   design = ~ group + 0)
        deseq_res <- DESeq2::DESeq(deseq_dt)
        hfd_hfe_res <- DESeq2::results(object = deseq_res, contrast = list("groupHFE", "groupHFD"))
        return(rownames(hfd_hfe_res)[hfd_hfe_res$padj <= 0.05 & !is.na(hfd_hfe_res$padj)])
    } else if(exp_id == "WGB_DNA_Methylation"){
        return(rownames(exp_dt)[rowData(exp_dt)$`HFE-HFD.adj.p.value` <= 0.05])
    }else{
        filt_exp <- exp_dt[,exp_dt$group %in% c("HFD", "HFE")]
    
        filt_exp$group <- droplevels(filt_exp$group)
        keep_vars <- apply(as.matrix(assay(filt_exp)), 1, function(x){
            !any(tapply(x, filt_exp$group, function(x){all(is.na(x))}))
        })
        print(sum(keep_vars))
        filt_exp <- filt_exp[keep_vars,]
        
        tests_1 <- apply(assay(filt_exp), 1, function(var_dt){
            wilcox.test(var_dt ~ droplevels(filt_exp$group))$p.value
        })
        return(names(which(p.adjust(tests_1, "fdr") < 0.05)))
    }
})
names(hfd_hfe_res_test) <- names(experiments(multi_omics_raw)[sel_multi_omics_mofa])

hfe_fc_list <- lapply(experiments(multi_omics_raw), function(exp_dt){
    cnt_means <- rowMeans(as.matrix(assay(exp_dt[,exp_dt$group == "CNT"])))
    hfe_means <- rowMeans(as.matrix(assay(exp_dt[,exp_dt$group == "HFE"])))
    hfd_means <- rowMeans(as.matrix(assay(exp_dt[,exp_dt$group == "HFD"])))
    
    hfe_cnt_fc <- log2(hfe_means/cnt_means)
    hfd_cnt_fc <- log2(hfd_means/cnt_means)
    data.frame("HFD-CNT.log2FC.m" = hfd_cnt_fc, "HFE-CNT.log2FC.m" = hfe_cnt_fc)
})
hfe_hfd_same_dir <- lapply(hfe_fc_list, function(x){
    rownames(x)[rowSums(x < 0) != 1]
})
hfe_hfd_diff_dir <- lapply(hfe_fc_list, function(x){
    rownames(x)[rowSums(x < 0) == 1]
```

```{r}
source("../Utility_Functions/utilities.R")
library(impute)

multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma <- multi_omics_raw
multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma <- multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma[,,lengths(multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma) != 0]
# Re-applying normalizations including the HFE excluded mice
proc_omics <- lapply(names(experiments(multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma)), function(omic_name){
    param_list <- list()
    function_list <- list()
    print(omic_name)
    omic_proc <- experiments(multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma)[[omic_name]]
    
    if(grepl("WGB_DNA", omic_name)){
        function_list <- list(impute_knn_assay, scale_assay)
    }
    if(grepl("RNA_Sequencing", omic_name)){
        function_list <- list(count_vst_deseq2, scale_assay)
    }
    if(grepl("Untargeted", omic_name)){
        function_list <- list(impute_knn_assay, count_vst_deseq2, scale_assay)
    }
    if(grepl("Targeted", omic_name)){
        function_list <- list(impute_knn_assay, count_vst_deseq2, scale_assay)
    }
    if(grepl("Histone", omic_name)){
        function_list <- list(scale_assay)
    }
    if(grepl("16S|Shotgun_Metagenomics", omic_name)){
        function_list <- list(count_vst_deseq2, scale_assay)
    }
    if(grepl("Metallomics", omic_name)){
        function_list <- list(scale_assay)
    }
    
    for(fun in function_list){
        omic_proc <- do.call(fun, c(list("omic_dt" = omic_proc), 
                                    param_list))
    }
    omic_proc
})
names(proc_omics) <- names(assays(multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma))
experiments(multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma) <- ExperimentList(proc_omics)
f2_multi_omics_raw_ma <- multi_omics_hfe_raw_ma[f2_mofa_vars_full,,]
```

```{r}
pdf("f2_hfe_included_heatmaps.pdf")
lapply(names(experiments(f2_multi_omics_raw_ma)), function(exp_id){
    exp_dt <- experiments(f2_multi_omics_raw_ma)[[exp_id]]
    exp_dt <- exp_dt[,exp_dt$group != "INT"]
    exp_dt$group <- droplevels(exp_dt$group)
    levels(exp_dt$group) <- c("CNT", "HFD", "HFDex")
    exp_cd <- as.data.frame(colData(exp_dt))
    
    exp_assay <- t(as.data.frame(assay(exp_dt)))
    
    if(nrow(exp_dt) < 5){
        lapply(colnames(exp_assay), function(var_id){
            var_dt <- cbind(as.data.frame(exp_assay)[var_id], as.data.frame(exp_cd)["group"])
            p1 <- ggplot(var_dt, aes(x = group, y = .data[[var_id]], fill = group)) + 
                geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + 
                scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict_ext)
            print(p1)
        })

        pheatmap::pheatmap(exp_assay, annotation_row = as.data.frame(exp_cd)["group"], 
                            show_colnames = FALSE, clustering_method = "average", 
                            annotation_colors = list("group" = group_color_dict_ext[c(1,2,4)]),
                            main = exp_id)
```


```{r}
variables_dicts <- lapply(names(omic_dt), function(omic_name){
    if(omic_name == "RNA_Sequencing"){
        return("gene_lab")
    } else if(omic_name == "Untargeted_Metabolomics"){
        return("compounds_merged_readable")
        #return("HFD-CNT.formula")
    } else if(grepl("DNA_Methylation", omic_name)){
        return("geneName")
    } else if(grepl("16S|Targeted|Shotgun.*Functional", omic_name)){
        return("readable_name")  
    } else{
        return(NA)
    }
})

test_wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(test_wb, sheetName = "rna_seq")
addWorksheet(test_wb, sheetName = "unt_met")
addWorksheet(test_wb, sheetName = "cogs")
addWorksheet(test_wb, sheetName = "dna_met")

writeData(wb = test_wb, sheet = "rna_seq", x = as.data.frame(rowData(mo_f2_hfe_no_hfd_hfe_sig[["RNA_Sequencing"]])))
writeData(wb = test_wb, sheet = "unt_met", 
        x = as.data.frame(rowData(mo_f2_hfe_no_hfd_hfe_sig[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]))[,sapply(rowData(mo_f2_hfe_no_hfd_hfe_sig[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]), class) != "list"])

writeData(wb = test_wb, sheet = "dna_met", x = as.data.frame(rowData(mo_f2_hfe_no_hfd_hfe_sig[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])))
writeData(wb = test_wb, sheet = "cogs", x = as.data.frame(rowData(mo_f2_hfe_no_hfd_hfe_sig[["Shotgun_Metagenomics_Functional.colon.cogs"]])))

saveWorkbook(test_wb, "test_hfd_ex_176_vars.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

### MOFA Plots

### Other models plot

```{r}
p_list <- list()
mofa_group_var <- colData(multi_omics_mofa_hfe)[["group"]]
names(mofa_group_var) <- colData(multi_omics_mofa_hfe)[["samplename"]]
# colData(multi_omics)$sample <- colData(multi_omics)$samplename

for(factor_num in num_factors){
    f_name <- paste0("Factor ", factor_num)
    f_mofa_dir_name <- paste0("test_hfd_ex_", factor_num, "c")
    f_output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", f_mofa_dir_name, "/")
    f_model <- MOFA2::load_model(file = paste0(f_output_dir, "model.hdf5"))

    rownames(samples_metadata(f_model)) <- samples_metadata(f_model)$sample

    samples_metadata(f_model)$groups <- droplevels(mofa_group_var[as.character(samples_metadata(f_model)$sample)])

    set.seed(11037)
    p1 <- plot_factor(f_model, group_by = "groups",
                    factors = 1:factor_num, dodge = FALSE,
                    color_by = "groups", add_violin = FALSE, add_dots = FALSE) +
            geom_violin(aes(fill = group_by), scale = "width",
                        alpha = 0.5, color = "transparent") +
            scale_color_manual(values= group_color_dict_hfe) +
            scale_fill_manual(values= group_color_dict_hfe) + labs(fill = "Group") +
            theme_minimal() + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
                                    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
                                    legend.title = element_blank()) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 3)) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1.8) +
        ggtitle(paste0("Model - ", factor_num, " factors"))
    if(factor_num < 10){p1 <- p1 + theme(legend.position = "none")}

    p1@data$factor <- gsub("Factor", "Factor ", p1@data$factor)

    p_list[[f_name]] <- p1
    # p1
    # ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "figure_11_a_alt.svg"), plot = p1,
    #         fix_text_size = FALSE)
    # ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "figure_11_a_alt.png"), plot = p1)
}
```

```{r}
mofa_seq_factors <- get_weights(mofa_model)

variable_2_omic_dt <- lapply(names(mofa_seq_factors), function(omic_id){
    var_2_omic <- rep(omic_id, nrow(mofa_seq_factors[[omic_id]]))
    names(var_2_omic) <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors[[omic_id]])
    var_2_omic
})
```

```{r}
mofa_vars_plot_dt <- lapply(unique(factor_1_cut), function(x){
    var_dt <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors_b)[factor_1_cut == x]
    var_dt_pos <- var_dt[var_dt %in% rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[mofa_seq_factors[,1] < 0 &

    data.frame("group" = group_var$group,

            "belonging" = x, "var_type" = "opposite")

})
```

```{r}
#                                                 mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] > 0.3]
# Divisors
# f1 > 0 / f2 < 0

# 0-0.4 Kept completely altered

# 0.4-0.5 Resistant to restoration

# 0.5-1 Completely Restored 
#####
# f1 > 0 / f2 > 0
# 0-0.3 Altered and worsened with intervention
## 0.3-0.6 Altered by the intervention only
## 0.6-0.7 Small HFD alterations high intervention changes
# 0.7-1 Changes in HFD and high intervention changes

# A partir de 0.6-0.7 ja podem assignar cada variable a un factor (0.3 millor)
# f1 > 0 / f2 < 0 -> Alteració i mantenirse 
# f1 > 0 / f2 > 0 -> Alteració petita i recuperar-se més dels CTR 

# Entre 0-0.4 del F2
```

#### Overlap Hist 

```{r}
observed_overlap <- length(intersect(f1_mofa_vars_full,
                                    f1_mofa_vars_full_hfe))

lima_all <- length(unlist(sapply(experiments(multi_omics), rownames)))

f1_int_size <- length(f1_mofa_vars_full)
f1_hfe_size <- length(f1_mofa_vars_full_hfe)

set.seed(11037)

sample_res <- replicate(n = 10000, {
    gf1 <- sample(lima_all, f1_int_size, replace = FALSE)
    lm1 <- sample(lima_all, f1_hfe_size, replace = FALSE)
    length(intersect(gf1, lm1))
})

sum(observed_overlap < sample_res)/length(sample_res) *2

observed_overlap/mean(sample_res)

p_val <- pnorm(observed_overlap, mean(sample_res), sd(sample_res), lower.tail = FALSE)

# genes overlap hist

p1 <- ggplot() +
        geom_histogram(aes(x = sample_res), binwidth = 2, 
                        fill = "lightblue") + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        xlab("Number of overlapping variables in a sample") + ylab("Frequency") +
        ggtitle(paste0("All MOFA variables overlap empirical null distribution \n", "(", 
                    f1_int_size ,  " INT model / ", 
                    f1_hfe_size, " HFDex model sample size)")) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = observed_overlap) + 
        annotate(x = observed_overlap + 3, y = 0, geom = "text", label = observed_overlap) +
        annotate(x = observed_overlap + 3, y = 0 + 200, geom = "text", label = round(p_val, 4))
p1

ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "Supp_Figure_F1_INT_F1_HFDex_Overlap_Hist.svg"), 
        plot = p1, fix_text_size = FALSE)
```

#### Heatmap 

```{r}
pdf("f1int_f1hfe_heatmaps.pdf")
lapply(names(experiments(multi_omics_mofa_hfe)), function(exp_id){
    exp_dt <- experiments(multi_omics_mofa_hfe[f1int_f1hde_overlapping,,])[[exp_id]]
    exp_dt <- exp_dt[,exp_dt$group != "INT"]
    exp_dt$group <- droplevels(exp_dt$group)
    levels(exp_dt$group) <- c("CNT", "HFD", "HFDex")
    
    exp_cd <- as.data.frame(colData(exp_dt))
    
    exp_assay <- t(as.data.frame(assay(exp_dt)))
    
    if(nrow(exp_dt) < 5){
        lapply(colnames(exp_assay), function(var_id){
            var_dt <- cbind(as.data.frame(exp_assay)[var_id], as.data.frame(exp_cd)["group"])
            p1 <- ggplot(var_dt, aes(x = group, y = .data[[var_id]], fill = group)) + 
                geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + 
                scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict_ext)
            print(p1)
        })
    } else{
        pheatmap::pheatmap(exp_assay, annotation_row = as.data.frame(exp_cd)["group"], 
                            show_colnames = FALSE, clustering_method = "average", 
                            annotation_colors = list("group" = group_color_dict_ext[c(1,2,4)]),
                            main = exp_id)
    }
    return(NULL)
})
dev.off()

                            show_colnames = FALSE, clustering_method = "average", 
                            annotation_colors = list("group" = group_color_dict_ext[c(1,2,4)]),
                            main = exp_id)
    }
    return(NULL)
})
```

## Factor 1 epigenetic relationships

### DNA Methylation MOFA factor

```{r}
rna_seq_dt <- omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]
dna_met_dt <- omic_dt[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]]

rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(rna_seq_dt))]
rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(dna_met_dt))]

factor_ids <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")
# Any overlap at 1 MB
info_1MB_overlap <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    rna_seq_factor <- rna_seq_dt[rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id &
                                    !is.na(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$start_position),]
    dna_met_factor <- dna_met_dt[rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id,]
    
    rna_seq_rr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
        seqnames = rowData(rna_seq_factor)$chromosome_id,
        ranges = IRanges(start = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_factor)$start_position) - 1e6,
        end = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_factor)$start_position) + 1e6,
        names = rownames(rna_seq_factor)))

    dna_met_dt_1mb <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_factor), function(gene_id){
        ov_dt <- findOverlaps(query = rowRanges(dna_met_factor), subject = rna_seq_rr[gene_id,], )
        found_dmrs <- rownames(dna_met_factor[ov_dt@from,])
        if(!length(found_dmrs)){return(NULL)}
        data.frame("DMR_ID" = found_dmrs, "Gene_ID" = gene_id)
    })

    dna_met_dt_1mb <- do.call(rbind, dna_met_dt_1mb)
    dna_met_dt_1mb$Factor_ID <- factor_id
    
    dna_met_dt_1mb$geneTSS <- as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_dt)[dna_met_dt_1mb$Gene_ID, "start_position"])
    dna_met_dt_1mb$dmr_mid <- rowMeans(cbind(rowData(dna_met_dt)[dna_met_dt_1mb$DMR_ID,]$geneStart,
                                    rowData(dna_met_dt)[dna_met_dt_1mb$DMR_ID,]$geneEnd))
    
    dna_met_dt_1mb$distanceToTSS <- abs(dna_met_dt_1mb$geneTSS - dna_met_dt_1mb$dmr_mid) 
    dna_met_dt_1mb
})
names(info_1MB_overlap) <- factor_ids

info_1MB_overlap <- do.call(rbind, info_1MB_overlap)

simplified_DMR_annotation <- sapply(rowData(dna_met_dt)$annotation, function(dmr_an){
            if(grepl("Promoter", dmr_an)){return("Promoter")
            } else if(grepl("Intron", dmr_an)){return("Intron")
            } else if(grepl("Exon", dmr_an)){return("Exon")
            } else if(grepl("Downstream", dmr_an)){return("Downstream")
            } else if(grepl("Distal Intergenic", dmr_an)){return("Distal Intergenic")
            } else if(grepl("Upstream", dmr_an)){return("Upstream")
            } else if(grepl("3' UTR", dmr_an)){return("3' UTR")
            } else if(grepl("5' UTR", dmr_an)){return("5' UTR")
            } else{"Other"}
        })
names(simplified_DMR_annotation) <- rownames(dna_met_dt)
info_1MB_overlap$DMR_region <- simplified_DMR_annotation[as.character(info_1MB_overlap$DMR_ID)]

```

### DNA Methylation MOFA factor correlations

```{r}
rna_seq_dt <- omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]
assayNames(rna_seq_dt) <- "dt1"

rna_seq_raw <- multi_omics_raw[["RNA_Sequencing"]]

sum(rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% rownames(tf_genes))/nrow(rna_seq_raw)*100


rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(rna_seq_dt))]
table(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor)

dna_met_dt <- omic_dt[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]]
rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(dna_met_dt))]
table(rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor)

assayNames(dna_met_dt) <- "dt1"

overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_seq_dt), colnames(dna_met_dt))

dmr_gene_corr_path <- paste0(output_dir, "dmr_gene_full_correlations.rds")

if(!file.exists(dmr_gene_corr_path)){
    info_1MB_overlap_corr <- lapply(unique(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor), function(factor_id){
        
        
        rna_seq_factor <- rna_seq_dt[rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id &
                                        !is.na(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$start_position),]
        dna_met_factor <- dna_met_dt[rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id,]
        
        corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(
            x = rna_seq_factor[,overlap_samples],
            experiment2 = dna_met_factor[,overlap_samples],
            method = "pearson",
            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
            assay.type2 = "dt1",
            test_significance =  TRUE)
        corr_dt
    })
    names(info_1MB_overlap_corr) <- unique(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor)
    info_1MB_overlap_corr <- lapply(names(info_1MB_overlap_corr), function(factor_id){
        corr_dt <- info_1MB_overlap_corr[[factor_id]] 
        corr_dt$Factor_ID <- factor_id
        corr_dt
    })
    
    info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge <- do.call(rbind, info_1MB_overlap_corr)
    
    info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge$DMR_gene <- dmr2ensembl[as.character(info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge[["Var2"]])]
    
    saveRDS(info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge, dmr_gene_corr_path)
} else{
    info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge <- readRDS(dmr_gene_corr_path)
}
```

#### F2 Correlations

```{r}
f2_correlation_dt <- info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge[info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge$Factor_ID == "Factor_2",]

f2_info_1MB_overlap <- info_1MB_overlap[info_1MB_overlap$Factor_ID == "Factor_2",]

pasted_ids_f2 <- paste(f2_info_1MB_overlap$DMR_ID, 
                    f2_info_1MB_overlap$Gene_ID)
pasted_ids_2_f2 <- paste(f2_correlation_dt$Var2,
                        f2_correlation_dt$Var1)

pasted_ids_direct_f2 <- pasted_ids_f2[f2_info_1MB_overlap$`Interaction Type` == "Direct"]

f2_correlation_dt[["is1MB_close"]] <- pasted_ids_2_f2 %in% pasted_ids_f2
f2_correlation_dt[["is_own_dmr"]] <- pasted_ids_2_f2 %in% pasted_ids_direct_f2
f2_correlation_dt[["p_adj"]] <- p.adjust(f2_correlation_dt[["pval"]], "fdr")
f2_correlation_dt[["isSignificant"]] <- f2_correlation_dt[["p_adj"]] <= 0.05
```

```{r}
    f2_correlation_dt[["is_close_TSS_1MB_mean"]] &
    f2_correlation_dt[["DMR_region"]] == "Distal Intergenic"
```

#### F1 Correlations

```{r}
f1_correlation_dt <- info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge[info_1MB_overlap_corr_merge$Factor_ID == "Factor_1",]
f1_correlation_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(f1_correlation_dt$pval, "fdr")
f1_correlation_dt$sig <- f1_correlation_dt$p_adj <= 0.05

f1_info_1MB_overlap <- info_1MB_overlap[info_1MB_overlap$Factor_ID == "Factor_1",]

pasted_ids <- paste(f1_info_1MB_overlap$DMR_ID, 
                    f1_info_1MB_overlap$Gene_ID)
pasted_ids_2 <- paste(f1_correlation_dt$Var2,
                        f1_correlation_dt$Var1)

pasted_ids_direct <- pasted_ids[f1_info_1MB_overlap$`Interaction Type` == "Direct"]

f1_correlation_dt[["is1MB_close"]] <- pasted_ids_2 %in% pasted_ids
f1_correlation_dt[["is_own_dmr"]] <- pasted_ids_2 %in% pasted_ids_direct
f1_correlation_dt[["p_adj"]] <- p.adjust(f1_correlation_dt[["pval"]], "fdr")
f1_correlation_dt[["isSignificant"]] <- f1_correlation_dt[["p_adj"]] <= 0.05

start_tss_gene_dict <- as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$start_position)
names(start_tss_gene_dict) <- rownames(rna_seq_dt)

f1_correlation_dt[["gene_tss"]] <- start_tss_gene_dict[as.character(f1_correlation_dt[["Var1"]])]

mean_dmr_pos_dict <- round(rowMeans(as.matrix(as.data.frame(ranges(dna_met_dt))[,c("start", "end")])), 0)
names(mean_dmr_pos_dict) <- rownames(dna_met_dt)

f1_correlation_dt[["DMR_mean"]] <- mean_dmr_pos_dict[as.character(f1_correlation_dt[["Var2"]])]

f1_correlation_dt[["TSS_distance"]] <- abs(f1_correlation_dt[["DMR_mean"]] - f1_correlation_dt[["gene_tss"]]) 

start_tss_gene_dict <- as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$start_position)
names(start_tss_gene_dict) <- rownames(rna_seq_dt)

gene_chromosome <- rowData(rna_seq_dt)$chromosome_id
dmr_chromosome <- as.character(seqnames(dna_met_dt))

mean_dmr_pos_dict <- rowMeans(as.matrix(rowData(dna_met_dt)[,c("geneStart", "geneEnd")]))
names(mean_dmr_pos_dict) <- rownames(dna_met_dt)

names(dmr_chromosome) <- rownames(dna_met_dt)
names(gene_chromosome) <- rownames(rna_seq_dt)

f1_correlation_dt[["dmr_chromosome"]] <- dmr_chromosome[as.character(f1_correlation_dt[["Var2"]])]
f1_correlation_dt[["gene_chromosome"]] <- gene_chromosome[as.character(f1_correlation_dt[["Var1"]])]

f1_correlation_dt[["same_chromosome"]] <- f1_correlation_dt[["gene_chromosome"]] == f1_correlation_dt[["dmr_chromosome"]] & !is.na(f1_correlation_dt[["gene_chromosome"]]) & !is.na(f1_correlation_dt[["dmr_chromosome"]])

f1_correlation_dt[["DMR_region"]] <- as.factor(simplified_DMR_annotation[as.character(f1_correlation_dt[["Var2"]])])

f1_correlation_dt[["is_close_TSS_1MB_mean"]] <- f1_correlation_dt[["TSS_distance"]] <= 1e6

f1_correlation_dt[["distal_intergenic_1MB_corr"]] <- f1_correlation_dt[["same_chromosome"]] &
    f1_correlation_dt[["is_close_TSS_1MB_mean"]] &
    f1_correlation_dt[["DMR_region"]] == "Distal Intergenic"
```

##### Number of significant variables

###### F1 Gene Body DMRs - All correlations

```{r}
region_ids <- c("5' UTR", "3' UTR", 
                "Exon", "Intron", "Promoter")

sample_region_list <- table(f1_correlation_filt[["DMR_region"]])[region_ids]

sig_vars_table <- table(f1_correlation_dt[["isSignificant"]], 
                        f1_correlation_dt[["DMR_region"]],
                        f1_correlation_dt[["is_own_dmr"]])
sig_vars_table <- sig_vars_table[2,,2][region_ids]

p_val_dt <- f1_correlation_dt[["p_adj"]]
ntries <- 1000
hist_dt_list <- lapply(sample_region_list, function(sample_num){
    print(sample_num)
    replicate(ntries, {
        sum(sample(p_val_dt, size = sample_num) < 0.05)
    })
}) 

lapply(seq_along(hist_dt_list), function(list_id){
    hist_dt <- hist_dt_list[[list_id]]
    
    neg_var <- sig_vars_table[list_id]
    set_size <- sample_region_list[list_id]
    test_1 <- pnorm(q = neg_var, mean(hist_dt), sd(hist_dt), lower.tail = FALSE)

    p1 <- qplot(x = hist_dt, geom = "histogram", binwidth = 2) + theme_minimal() + 
        xlab("Number of significant variables in a sample") + ylab("Frequency") +
        ggtitle(paste0("F1 all genes empirical null distribution \n", "(", 
                    set_size,  " sample size)\n", region_ids[list_id])) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = neg_var) + 
        annotate(x = neg_var + 3, y = 0, geom = "text", label = neg_var) +
        annotate(x = neg_var + 3, y = 0 + 200, geom = "text", label = round(test_1, 4))
    
    return(list(p1, test_1))
})
```

```{r}
    if(set_size == 0){test_1 <- 1}
    
    bw <- bw_list[[list_id]]
    p1 <- ggplot() + 
        geom_histogram(aes(x = hist_dt), fill = neg_pos_palette[1], 
                        binwidth = bw) + theme_minimal() + 
        xlab(NULL) + ylab("Frequency") +
        ggtitle(paste0(region_ids[list_id], "\n(", 
                    set_size, " sample size)")) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = neg_var, color = neg_pos_palette[2]) + 
        annotate(x = neg_var + 3, y = text_max[list_id] - 30, geom = "text", label = neg_var) +
        annotate(x = neg_var + 3, y = text_max[list_id], geom = "text", label = round(test_1, 4))

    return(p1)
})
```

```{r}
plot_dt_list <- lapply(seq_along(hist_dt_list), function(list_id){
    neg_var <- neg_pos_table[list_id]
    set_size <- region_table[list_id]
    
    hist_dt <- hist_dt_list[[list_id]]
    expected_cor_mean <- mean(hist_dt)

    expected_cor_sd <- sd(hist_dt)
    
    test_1 <- pnorm(q = neg_var, mean(hist_dt), sd(hist_dt), lower.tail = FALSE)
    
    plot_dt <- data.frame("Correlation_num" = round(c(expected_cor_mean, set_size - expected_cor_mean, 
                                    neg_var, set_size - neg_var)),
                        "Type" = c("Expected", "Expected", "Observed", "Observed"),
                        "Direction" = c("Negative", "Positive", "Negative", "Positive"),
                        "DMR_Region" = region_ids[list_id],
                        "Standard_Deviation" = c(expected_cor_sd,expected_cor_sd, 0, 0))
    return(plot_dt)
})
plot_dt_list <- do.call(rbind, plot_dt_list)
```

##### Absolute correlation values

```{r}
ntries <- 1000
region_ids <- c("5' UTR", "3' UTR", 
                "Exon", "Intron", "Promoter", "Distal Intergenic")

region_table <- table(f1_correlation_dt_sig[["DMR_region"]][f1_correlation_dt_sig[["GBD_DMRs_and_1MB_DI"]]])[region_ids]
region_table[is.na(region_table)] <- 0
mean_abs_corr <- tapply(abs(f1_correlation_dt_sig[f1_correlation_dt_sig$GBD_DMRs_and_1MB_DI,]$cor),
                        f1_correlation_dt_sig[f1_correlation_dt_sig$GBD_DMRs_and_1MB_DI,]$DMR_region, mean)
mean_abs_corr <- mean_abs_corr[region_ids]

mean_abs_corr <- tapply(abs(f1_correlation_dt_sig[f1_correlation_dt_sig$GBD_DMRs_and_1MB_DI,]$cor),
                        f1_correlation_dt_sig[f1_correlation_dt_sig$GBD_DMRs_and_1MB_DI,]$DMR_region, mean)


cor_list <- f1_correlation_dt_sig$cor

hist_dt_list <- lapply(region_table, function(sample_num){
    replicate(ntries, {
        mean(abs(sample(cor_list, size = sample_num)))
    })
}) 
hist_dt_list[[1]] <- 0

lapply(seq_along(hist_dt_list), function(list_id){
    hist_dt <- hist_dt_list[[list_id]]
    
    neg_var <- mean_abs_corr[list_id]
    set_size <- region_table[list_id]
    test_1 <- pnorm(q = neg_var, mean(hist_dt), sd(hist_dt), lower.tail = FALSE)

    p1 <- qplot(x = hist_dt, geom = "histogram") + theme_minimal() + 
        xlab("Number of negative correlations in a sample") + ylab("Frequency") +
        ggtitle(paste0("F1 1MB genes empirical null distribution \n", "(", 
                        set_size,  " sample size)\n", region_ids[list_id])) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = neg_var) + 
        annotate(x = neg_var + 0.05, y = 0, geom = "text", label = round(neg_var, 2)) +
        annotate(x = neg_var + 0.05, y = 0 + 100, geom = "text", label = round(test_1, 4))
    
    
    return(p1)
})
```

Que volem testejar exactament -> 
- Nombre de variables significatives en Gene Body DMRs és més alt que correlacions més llunyanes
    - Dubtes: 
        - Espai on fem el test: 433 gene body DMRs del Factor 1 / Totes les Gene Body DMRs
        - Espai de null distribution: < 1 MB (F1) correlations / Independent of distance correlations
        
- Valor absolut de correlació en Gene Body DMRs és més alt que correlacions més llunyanes
    - Dubtes: 
        - Espai on fem el test: 433 gene body DMRs del Factor 1 / Totes les Gene Body DMRs
        - Espai de null distribution: < 1 MB F1 correlations / Independent of distance correlations

##### TFs tests

```{r}
rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_TF <- rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% rownames(tf_genes)

rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_F1 <- rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% rownames(f1_multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])

rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_F2 <- rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% rownames(f2_multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])


rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_F1_corr <- rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% f1_sig_own_genes
rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_F2_corr <- rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% f2_sig_own_genes

rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_Sig <- rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% rownames(rna_seq_dt)

```

```{r}
rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_TF <- rownames(rna_seq_dt) %in% rownames(tf_genes)

rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_F1 <- rownames(rna_seq_dt) %in% rownames(f1_multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])

rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_F1_corr <- rownames(rna_seq_dt) %in% f1_sig_own_genes
rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_F2_corr <- rownames(rna_seq_dt) %in% f2_sig_own_genes

rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_gbdmr_gene <- NA
rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_gbdmr_gene[rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_F1_corr] <- "Factor_1_GB"
rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_gbdmr_gene[rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_F2_corr] <- "Factor_2_GB"
rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_gbdmr_gene[is.na(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$is_gbdmr_gene)] <- "Factor_2_GB"
```


```{r}
rna_seq_rd <- rowData(rna_seq_dt)

fc_cols_dt <- rna_seq_rd[,(grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(rna_seq_rd)) & 
                                grepl("log2FC", colnames(rna_seq_rd))) |
                            grepl("Full_Factor", colnames(rna_seq_rd))]

fc_cols_dt <- reshape2::melt(as.data.frame(fc_cols_dt))
fc_cols_dt <- fc_cols_dt[fc_cols_dt$Full_Factor %in% factor_ids,]

ggplot(fc_cols_dt, aes(x = abs(value), fill = Full_Factor)) + 
    geom_histogram(position = "dodge", binwidth = 0.2) + 
    facet_grid(cols = vars(variable))
ggplot(fc_cols_dt, aes(y = abs(value), fill = Full_Factor)) + 
    geom_boxplot() + 
    facet_grid(cols = vars(variable))

aov_test <- aov(value ~ variable * Full_Factor, data = fc_cols_dt)
summary(aov_test)
TukeyHSD(aov_test)

kruskal.test(value ~ paste(variable, Full_Factor), data = fc_cols_dt)

fc_wilcox_list <- lapply(unique(fc_cols_dt$variable), function(var_id){
    fc_test <- fc_cols_dt[fc_cols_dt$variable == var_id,]
    list("test" = wilcox.test(abs(value) ~ Full_Factor, data = fc_test), 
        "medians" = tapply(abs(fc_test$value), fc_test$Full_Factor, median))
})
names(fc_wilcox_list) <- unique(fc_cols_dt$variable)

ggplot(fc_cols_dt, aes(y = abs(value), fill = Full_Factor)) + 
    geom_boxplot() + 
    facet_grid(cols = vars(variable))
```

###### Sig - All TF test

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
## F1 associated permutation test
set.seed(11037)
ntries <- 10000
set_size <- sum(rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_Sig)
hist_dt <- replicate(ntries, {
    sum(rowData(rna_seq_raw)[sample(rownames(rna_seq_raw), size = set_size),]$is_TF)    
})
f1_tf_num <- sum(rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_TF & rowData(rna_seq_raw)$is_Sig)

qplot(x = hist_dt, geom = "histogram") + theme_minimal() + 
    xlab("Number of TF in a sample") + ylab("Frequency") +
    ggtitle(paste0("All genes empirical null distribution \n", "(", set_size, " sample size)")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = f1_tf_num) + 
    annotate(x = f1_tf_num - 30, y = 0, geom = "text", label = f1_tf_num)

pnorm(q = f1_tf_num, mean(hist_dt), sd(hist_dt), lower.tail = FALSE)

## F1 associated test Chi-Squared test
t1 <- table(as.data.frame(rowData(rna_seq_raw))[,c("is_TF", "is_F1")])
t1_chi <- chisq.test(t1)
plot_dt1 <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(t1_chi$observed))
plot_dt2 <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(t1_chi$expected)) 
plot_dt1$type <- "Observed"
plot_dt2$type <- "Expected"
plot_dt_merged <- rbind(plot_dt1, plot_dt2)

ggplot(plot_dt_merged) + geom_col(aes(x = type, fill = is_TF, 
                                      y = value), width = 0.3, position = "fill") + facet_grid(vars(is_F1)) + theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
## All GBD genes
gene_info <- as.data.frame(rna_seq_rd[f1_sig_own_genes,])
gene_body_genes <- gene_info[,c("entrezID", "symbol", "gene_name", "chromosome_id", "Factor_1_weights", "Factor_2_weights")]
gene_body_genes$Factor_1_weights <- round(gene_body_genes$Factor_1_weights, 2)
gene_body_genes$Factor_2_weights <- round(gene_body_genes$Factor_2_weights, 2)
library(openxlsx)
gene_body_dmr_wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(gene_body_dmr_wb, sheetName = "gene_body_dmr_genes")
writeData(gene_body_dmr_wb, sheet = "gene_body_dmr_genes", gene_body_genes, row.names = TRUE)
saveWorkbook(gene_body_dmr_wb, file = "../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/f1_gene_body_dmr_genes.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

## All GBD TF genes
gene_info <- as.data.frame(rowData(rna_seq_dt[f1_sig_own_genes[f1_sig_own_genes %in% rownames(tf_genes)],]))
gene_body_tfs <- gene_info[,c("entrezID", "symbol", "gene_name", "chromosome_id", "Factor_1_weights", "Factor_2_weights")]
gene_body_tfs$Factor_1_weights <- round(gene_body_tfs$Factor_1_weights, 2)
gene_body_tfs$Factor_2_weights <- round(gene_body_tfs$Factor_2_weights, 2)
```

```{r}
all_tf_nodes <- V(tf_nw_f1)[names(V(tf_nw_f1)) %in% rownames(tf_genes)]

    tf_sample <- sample(all_tf_nodes, size = length(tf_nodes))

    full_dist_f1 <- distances(tf_nw_f1, v = tf_sample, mode = "out")
    
    min_dist <- apply(full_dist_f1, 2, function(x){
        x_dt <- x[x != 0]
        min(x_dt)
    })
    as.data.frame(table(min_dist)/sum(table(min_dist))*100)
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

```{r}
table(rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor)
```

```{r}
rna_seq_rd <- rowData(rna_seq_dt)

fc_cols_dt <- rna_seq_rd[,(grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(rna_seq_rd)) & 
                                grepl("log2FC", colnames(rna_seq_rd))) |
                            grepl("Full_Factor", colnames(rna_seq_rd))]
fc_cols_dt$Variable_ID <- rownames(fc_cols_dt)

fc_cols_dt$isGBDMR <- rownames(fc_cols_dt) %in% c(f1_sig_own_genes, f2_sig_own_genes)


fc_cols_dt <- reshape2::melt(as.data.frame(fc_cols_dt))
fc_cols_dt <- fc_cols_dt[fc_cols_dt$Full_Factor %in% factor_ids,]

std <- function(x) sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))

fc_cols_dt_summ <- fc_cols_dt %>% group_by(isGBDMR, variable, Full_Factor) %>% 
    summarize("mean_dt" = mean(abs(value)), 
            "sd_min" = mean(abs(value)) - sd(abs(value)),
            "sd_max" = mean(abs(value)) + sd(abs(value)),
            "se_min" = mean(abs(value)) - std(abs(value)),
            "se_max" = mean(abs(value)) + std(abs(value)))
fc_cols_dt_summ$sd_min[fc_cols_dt_summ$sd_min < 0 ] <- 0
levels(fc_cols_dt_summ$variable) <- c("HFD vs CNT", "INT vs CNT", "INT vs HFD")
fc_cols_dt_summ$Full_Factor <- factor(fc_cols_dt_summ$Full_Factor, levels = factor_ids,
                                    labels = c("Factor 1", "Factor 2"))

fc_cols_dt_summ$isGBDMR <- factor(fc_cols_dt_summ$isGBDMR, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), 
                                  labels = c("No DMR", "Gene Body DMR genes"))

ggplot(fc_cols_dt_summ, aes(x = variable, y = mean_dt, fill = isGBDMR)) + 
    geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
    facet_grid(cols = vars(Full_Factor)) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = sd_min,
```

### Histone Modifications correlations & Gene-DMR correlations analysis

```{r}
rna_seq_dt <- omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]
assayNames(rna_seq_dt) <- "dt1"

rna_seq_raw <- multi_omics_raw[["RNA_Sequencing"]]

sum(rownames(rna_seq_raw) %in% rownames(tf_genes))/nrow(rna_seq_raw)*100


rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(rna_seq_dt))]
table(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor)


hist_dt <- omic_dt[["Histone_Modifications_Proteomics"]]
assayNames(hist_dt) <- "dt1"

hist_dt_raw <- multi_omics_raw[["Histone_Modifications_Proteomics"]]


rowData(hist_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(hist_dt))]
table(rowData(hist_dt)$Full_Factor)


overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_seq_dt), colnames(hist_dt))

hist_genes_corr <- lapply(unique(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor), function(factor_id){
    
    rna_seq_factor <- rna_seq_dt[rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id &
                                    !is.na(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$start_position),]
    hist_dt_factor <- hist_dt[rowData(hist_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id,]
    
    if(nrow(hist_dt_factor) == 0 | nrow(rna_seq_factor) == 0){return(NA)}
    
    corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(
        x = rna_seq_factor[,overlap_samples],
        experiment2 = hist_dt_factor[,overlap_samples],
        method = "pearson",
        assay.type1 = "dt1", 
        assay.type2 = "dt1",
        test_significance =  TRUE)
    corr_dt
})
names(hist_genes_corr) <- unique(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor)

hist_genes_corr <- lapply(names(hist_genes_corr), function(factor_id){
    corr_dt <- hist_genes_corr[[factor_id]] 
    if(all(is.na(corr_dt))){return(NA)}
    corr_dt$Factor_ID <- factor_id
    corr_dt
})

hist_genes_corr_merge <- do.call(rbind, hist_genes_corr)

hist_genes_corr_merge_sig <- hist_genes_corr_merge[hist_genes_corr_merge$p_adj <= 0.05,]
sort(table(hist_genes_corr_merge_sig$Var1), decreasing = TRUE)

# t.test(abs(hist_genes_corr_merge_sig$cor) ~ hist_genes_corr_merge_sig$is_dmr_regulated)
```

```{r}
f1_dmr_gene_body_corr_sig <- f1_correlation_dt[f1_correlation_dt[["is_own_dmr"]] & f1_correlation_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]

dmr_gene_body_ensembl <- table(f1_dmr_gene_body_corr_sig$Var1)
histone_gene_body_ensembl <- table(hist_genes_corr_merge_sig$Var1)

dmr_gene_body_ensembl <- dmr_gene_body_ensembl[names(histone_gene_body_ensembl)]

dmr_hist_gene_corrs <- lapply(union(names(dmr_gene_body_ensembl), 
        names(histone_gene_body_ensembl)), function(x){
            hist_gene_num_corrs <- histone_gene_body_ensembl[x]
            hist_gene_num_corrs[is.na(hist_gene_num_corrs)] <- 0
            
            dmr_gene_num_corrs <- dmr_gene_body_ensembl[x]
            dmr_gene_num_corrs[is.na(dmr_gene_num_corrs)] <- 0

            data.frame("Gene" = x, "Correlated_Histone_Num" = unname(hist_gene_num_corrs),
                       "Correlated_DMR_Num" = unname(dmr_gene_num_corrs))
})
dmr_hist_gene_corrs <- do.call(rbind, dmr_hist_gene_corrs)


cor.test(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num, dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num)
ggplot(data = dmr_hist_gene_corrs, 
       aes(x = Correlated_Histone_Num, y = Correlated_DMR_Num)) + 
    geom_point() + geom_smooth(method='lm') + 
    theme_minimal() + xlab("Number of Histone Correlations") + ylab("Number of DMR correlations") 
```

```{r}
chi_test_0 <- chisq.test(table(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num > 0, dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num > 0))
chi_test_0$observed
chi_test_0$expected

dmr_hist_gene_corrs$isDMR_Correlated <- ifelse(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num > 0, "Yes", "No")
tapply(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num, as.factor(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num > 0), mean)
tapply(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num, as.factor(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num > 0), hist)

hist_mean_dt <- tapply(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num, as.factor(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num > 0), median)

ntries <- 1000
set_size <- nrow(dmr_hist_gene_corrs)

stat_hist <- replicate(ntries, {
    new_grouping <- sample(x = dmr_hist_gene_corrs$isDMR_Correlated, size = set_size)
    t.test(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num ~ new_grouping)$statistic
})

wilcox.test(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num ~ as.factor(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num > 0))

observed_stat <- t.test(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_Histone_Num ~ as.factor(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Correlated_DMR_Num > 0))$statistic

sum(stat_hist < observed_stat)

dmr_hist_gene_corrs$is_TF <- ifelse(dmr_hist_gene_corrs$Gene %in% rownames(tf_genes), "Yes", "No")
```

### MOFA factor enrichment

```{r}
rna_seq_dt <- omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]
rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(rna_seq_dt))]
table(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor)

unique(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor)
lapply(unique(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor), function(factor_id){
    found_genes <- rna_seq_dt[rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id,]
    
    pheatmap::pheatmap(as.matrix(assay(found_genes)), 
                    annotation_col = as.data.frame(colData(found_genes))[,"group", drop = FALSE],
                    show_rownames = FALSE, clustering_method = "average")
    return(NULL)
})

```

```{r}
set.seed(11037)

    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){

                                keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr",

        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res    
    })
})
```

```{r}
mofa_factor_kegg_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(weight_dt), 
                             column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = entrez_ids,
                                TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$type == "gene_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```

```{r}

        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = symbol_ids, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                pAdjustMethod = "fdr", TERM2GENE = term2gene_filt, TERM2NAME = term2name_filt,
                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = Inf)

        enrich_res
    })
})
```

### MOFA factor enrichment Microbiota Regulated

```{r}
rna_seq_full_gfcv <- readRDS("../../outputs/RNA_Sequencing/RNA_Sequencing_exp_gfcv.rds")

gfcv_vars <- readRDS("../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/gfcv_interesting_vars.rds")
genes_microb_reg <- rownames(gfcv_vars$`GFM-CVM`$RNA_Sequencing)
metab_microb_reg <- rownames(gfcv_vars$`GFM-CVM`$Untargeted_Metabolomics)
```

#### Overlap Hist F2 

```{r}
observed_overlap <- length(intersect(genes_microb_reg,
                                    rownames(f2_multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])))

gfcv_all <- rownames(rna_seq_full_gfcv)
lima_all <- rownames(multi_omics_raw[["RNA_Sequencing"]])

gfcv_sample_size <- length(genes_microb_reg)
lima_sample_size <- length(rownames(f2_multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]]))

set.seed(11037)

sample_res <- replicate(n = 10000, {
    gf1 <- sample(gfcv_all, gfcv_sample_size, replace = FALSE)
    lm1 <- sample(lima_all, lima_sample_size, replace = FALSE)
    length(intersect(gf1, lm1))
})

sum(observed_overlap < sample_res)/length(sample_res) *2
```

```{r}
expr_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- paste0("Full_Factor == ", "'", factor_id, "'")
    
    if(factor_id == "Factor_12" | factor_id == "Factor_3"){factor_id <- "Factor_1"}
    
    
    # list("All Weights" = as.expression(factor_expr),

})
expr_list
names(expr_list) <- factor_ids
```

```{r}
enrich_exp_list <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_expr_id){
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_expr_id]]
    range_dt <- rowData(rna_seq_dt)
    
    lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        found_range <- range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                    envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]
        found_range[rownames(found_range) %in% genes_microb_reg,]
    })
})
names(enrich_exp_list) <- names(expr_list)
```

##### GO enrich

```{r}
set.seed(11037)
mofa_factor_go_enrich_microb <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = rownames(weight_dt), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                                keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
        enrich_res <- clusterProfiler::simplify(enrich_res)
        
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res    
    })
})
```

##### KEGG enrich

```{r}
mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_microb <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(weight_dt), 
                             column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = entrez_ids,
                                TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$type == "gene_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```

```{r}
    universe_genes <- hfe_vars_list_bg[[factor_id]]

    entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(factor_dt), 
                         column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
    enrich_res <- enricher(gene = entrez_ids,
                            TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$type == "gene_id",], 
                            TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                            universe = universe_genes, maxGSSize = 500)
    if(is.null(enrich_res) || nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
    # enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
    enrich_res
})
names(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_hfe_bg) <- names(enrich_exp_list)
```

```{r}
full_dt <- rowData(unt_met_dt)

met_enrich_results <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]]

    factor_res <- lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        sig_ids <- full_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(full_dt)),]$compounds_kegg_merged
        sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";|/"))
        sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(sig_ids) & sig_ids != "NA"]
        
        enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids, universe = NULL,

})
```

```{r}
unt_met_rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(unt_met_dt))
```
