```{r}
feature_dict_met <- feature_dict_met[!is.na(feature_dict_met)]
feature_dict_met <- lapply(feature_dict_met, function(x){
    spli_c <- strsplit(x, split = ";|/")[[1]]
    spli_c <- gsub(" ", "", spli_c)
    
    if(all(spli_c == "NA")){return(NA)}
    spli_c[spli_c != "NA"]
})

set.seed(123)
met_gene_enrich_results <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]]
    
    factor_res <- lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        sig_ids <- unt_met_rd[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(unt_met_rd)),]$compounds_kegg_merged
        sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";|/"))
        sig_ids <- gsub(" ", "", sig_ids)

        sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(sig_ids) & sig_ids != "NA"]
        
        sig_ids_g <- rna_seq_rd[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(rna_seq_rd)),]$entrezID
        sig_ids_g <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids_g, ";"))
        sig_ids_g <- sig_ids_g[!is.na(sig_ids_g)]
        
        sig_ids_merge <- c(sig_ids_g, sig_ids)
        enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids_merge, universe = NULL, 
                            pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                            TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene,
                            TERM2NAME = kegg_db_list$term2name)
        
        enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_res = enrich_m, 
                                        featureDict = c(feature_dict_g,
                                                        feature_dict_met), 
                                        dt_type = "ora")
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
        enrich_m
    })
    factor_res
})
```

```{r}
    enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids_merge, universe = NULL, 
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                        TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene,
                        TERM2NAME = kegg_db_list$term2name)
    
    enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_res = enrich_m, 
```
```{r}
                                    featureDict = feature_dict, 
                                    dt_type = "ora")
    enrich_m@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
    enrich_m
})
```

```{r}
# unt_met_rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(unt_met_dt))
# 
# rna_seq_rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(rna_seq_dt))
# 
# feature_dict_g <- as.list(rna_seq_rd$entrezID)
# names(feature_dict_g) <- rownames(rna_seq_rd)


set.seed(11037)
met_gene_hfe_enrich_results_microb <- lapply(names(hfe_vars_list), function(factor_id){
    
    var_ids <- hfe_vars_list[[factor_id]]
    # dmr_regulated_genes <- unique(info_1MB_overlap$Gene_ID[info_1MB_overlap$Factor_ID == factor_id])
    
    # unt_met_found <- unt_met_rd[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
    #                         envir = as.data.frame(unt_met_rd)),]
    unt_met_found <- unt_met_rd[rownames(unt_met_rd) %in%
                                    var_ids &
                                rownames(unt_met_rd) %in% 
                                    rownames(gfcv_vars$`GFM-CVM`$Untargeted_Metabolomics),]
    
    sig_ids <- unt_met_found$compounds_kegg_merged
    sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";|/"))
    sig_ids <- gsub(" ", "", sig_ids)

    sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(sig_ids) & sig_ids != "NA"]
    
    # rna_seq_found <- rna_seq_rd[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
    #                         envir = as.data.frame(rna_seq_rd)),]
    rna_seq_found <- rna_seq_rd[rownames(rna_seq_rd) %in% 
                                    var_ids &
                                rownames(rna_seq_rd) %in%
                                    rownames(gfcv_vars$`GFM-CVM`$RNA_Sequencing),]

    feature_dict <- c(feature_dict_g[names(feature_dict_g) %in% rownames(rna_seq_found)],
                      feature_dict_met[names(feature_dict_met) %in% rownames(unt_met_found)])
    
    sig_ids_g <- rna_seq_found$entrezID
    sig_ids_g <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids_g, ";"))
    sig_ids_g <- sig_ids_g[!is.na(sig_ids_g)]
    # if(factor_id == "Factor_2"){browser()}
    sig_ids_merge <- c(sig_ids_g, sig_ids)
    enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids_merge, universe = NULL, 
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                        TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene,
                        TERM2NAME = kegg_db_list$term2name)
    
    enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_res = enrich_m, 
                                    featureDict = feature_dict, 
                                    dt_type = "ora")
    enrich_m@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
    enrich_m
})

names(met_gene_hfe_enrich_results_microb) <- names(hfe_vars_list)

    factor_dt <- met_gene_hfe_enrich_results_microb[[factor_id]]
        
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = results_wb,
                            sheetName = factor_id)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb = results_wb, sheet = factor_id,
                        x = as.data.frame(factor_dt))

}
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(results_wb, 
                        file = paste0(enrich_nw_dir, "Factor_Enrich_HFE_Microbiota_Reg_genes_metab.xlsx"), 
                        overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
clu_go <- mofa_factor_go_enrich$Factor_1$`All Weights`@result$ID

depth_num <- 2
go_find <- clu_go
for(depth_id in seq_len(depth_num)){
    test <- as.list(GO.db::GOBPPARENTS[go_find])
    go_find <- c(unique(unlist(test)), go_find)
    go_find <- go_find[go_find != "all"]
}
go_find <- go_find[go_find != "all"]
test_f <- as.list(GO.db::GOBPPARENTS[go_find])


test_df <- lapply(names(test_f), function(ids){
    data.frame("V1" = ids, "V2" = test_f[[ids]])
})
test_df <- do.call(rbind, test_df)

igraph_test <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(as.matrix(distinct(test_df)))

ig_colors <-ifelse(names(V(igraph_test)) %in% clu_go, "green", "grey")
```

```{r}
metab_rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(omic_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]))

# Finding the found adduct from each row
mummichog_feature_adduct <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(metab_rd)), function(row_id){
    factor_rd_row <- metab_rd[row_id,]
    if(is.na(factor_rd_row$input_row)){return(NA)}
    mummi_row_id <- factor_rd_row$input_row
    adduct_info <- factor_rd_row$str_row_ion
    
    adduct_merged <- sapply(strsplit(adduct_info, " / ")[[1]], function(m_adducts_list){
        adduct_vect <- sapply(strsplit(m_adducts_list, ";")[[1]], function(adduct_vect){
            adduct_found <- sapply(strsplit(adduct_vect, "_"),
                                function(adduct){
                if(adduct[1] == mummi_row_id){
                    return(adduct[2])
                } else{return(NA)}
            })
            adduct_found
        })
        adduct_vect[!is.na(adduct_vect)]
    })
    return(paste(adduct_merged, collapse = " / "))
})

rowData(omic_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]])$mummichog_adduct_found <- mummichog_feature_adduct

# Filtering usefull columns for annotation
factor_rd_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){

    factor_vars <- names(mofa_factor_variable)[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]
    factor_metab <- omic_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]

    as.data.frame(rowData(factor_metab))[,c(1:6, 20, 22, 23, 36, 
                                            37, 38, 39, 40, 41,

                                            92, 94, 96)]

})
names(factor_rd_list) <- factor_ids

kegg_db_list$term2name$name_filt <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "",
                                        kegg_db_list$term2name$name)

# Finding Hermes adduct information to calculate ppm error
adduct_table_p <- MetaboCoreUtils::adducts()

adduct_dict <- adduct_table_p$mass_add
names(adduct_dict) <- gsub("\\[|\\].*", "", adduct_table_p$name)
names(adduct_dict)[40] <- "M+"
adduct_dict[40] <- -0.00054857990924

adduct_table_n <- MetaboCoreUtils::adducts(polarity = "negative")
adduct_dict_n <- adduct_table_n$mass_add
names(adduct_dict_n) <- gsub("\\[|\\].*", "", adduct_table_n$name)
names(adduct_dict_n)[17] <- "M-"
adduct_dict_n[17] <- +0.00054857990924
adduct_dict <- c(adduct_dict, adduct_dict_n)

# found_info_list_dict <- found_info_list_dict[!duplicated(found_info_list_dict)]

# all_kegg_compounds[names(found_info_list_dict)] <- found_info_list_dict

# Finding mummichog annotations to calculate ppm errors
mummichog_adducts_dt <- unique(unlist(strsplit(mummichog_feature_adduct, " / ")))
mummichog_adducts_dt <- mummichog_adducts_dt[mummichog_adducts_dt != "NA" & !is.na(mummichog_adducts_dt)]
mummichog_adducts_dt

mummichog_adduct_mz <- rep(NA, length(mummichog_adducts_dt))

adducts_mumi_short <- gsub("\\[.*", "", mummichog_adducts_dt)

adduct_table_mumi_found <- adducts_mumi_short %in% names(adduct_dict)

names(mummichog_adduct_mz) <- mummichog_adducts_dt
mummichog_adduct_mz[adduct_table_mumi_found] <- adduct_dict[adducts_mumi_short[adduct_table_mumi_found]]

mummichog_adduct_mz["M[1+]"] <- adduct_dict[40]

names(mummichog_adduct_mz[is.na(mummichog_adduct_mz)])
missing_adducts <- names(mummichog_adduct_mz[is.na(mummichog_adduct_mz)])

library(MetaboCoreUtils)

missing_adducts_mz <- sapply(missing_adducts, function(adduct_id){
    adduct_id <- gsub("\\+2H", "\\+H2", adduct_id)
    adduct_id <- gsub("\\+3H", "\\+H3", adduct_id)
    
    if(grepl("M\\(C13\\)", adduct_id)){
        extra_sum <- 1.00866491606
    } else if(grepl("M\\(S34\\)", adduct_id)){
        extra_sum <- 1.00866491606*2
    } else{
        extra_sum <- 0
    }
    if(grepl("ACN", adduct_id)){return(NA)}
    
    electron_to_add <- ifelse(grepl("\\[.*\\+\\]", adduct_id), 
                            adduct_dict[40], adduct_dict[57])
    
    multiplicity <- ifelse(grepl("\\[.*\\+\\]$", adduct_id),
                           as.numeric(gsub("^.*\\[|[\\+]\\]$", "", adduct_id)),
                           1)

    adduct_id <- gsub("\\[.*\\]|M(\\(.*\\))*", "", adduct_id)
    
    adduct_sep <- strsplit(adduct_id, "(?=[+-])", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    adduct_mz <- sapply(grep("-|\\+", adduct_sep), function(term_found){
        calc_mass <- ifelse(adduct_sep[term_found] == "+",
               calculateMass(adduct_sep[term_found + 1]),
               -calculateMass(adduct_sep[term_found + 1]))
        return(calc_mass)
    })
    
    return((sum(adduct_mz) + extra_sum + electron_to_add)/multiplicity)
})

missing_adducts_mz["M+ACN-H[-]"] <- adduct_dict["M+C2H3N-H"]
mummichog_adduct_mz[is.na(mummichog_adduct_mz)] <- missing_adducts_mz


# Using all the information to calculate ppm error and other score to re-rank annotations depending on our confidence

metabolite_ordered_kegg_dt_path <- paste0(mofa_metab_path, "Metabolite_KEGG_data_ordered.rds")

if(!file.exists(metabolite_ordered_kegg_dt_path)){

    factor_rd_list_filt <- lapply(factor_rd_list, function(factor_met_dt){
        # Split Hermes variables
        kegg_vect_list <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$kegg_id, " / ")
        met_name_list <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$PutativeMetabolitesKEGG, " / ")
        
        neut_f_list <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$neutral_formula, " / ")
        adduct_met_list <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$adduct_annotation, " / ")
        iso_fi_list <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$iso_fidelity, " / ")
        iso_num_list <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$iso_num, " / ")
        
        # Calculate hermes ppm errors
        ppm_errors <- sapply(seq_along(adduct_met_list), function(list_id){
            row_formula <- neut_f_list[[list_id]]
            
            if(all(is.na(row_formula))){return(NA)}
            
            adduct_mass <- adduct_dict[adduct_met_list[[list_id]]]
            
            formula_mass <- sapply(row_formula, calculateMass)
            
            ionic_formula <- formula_mass + adduct_mass
            row_mz <- factor_met_dt$mzmed[list_id] 
            
            ppm_error <- abs((ionic_formula - row_mz)/row_mz) * 1e6
            round(ppm_error, 3)
        })
        
        # Calculate other associated features to each one
        m0s_dt <- factor_met_dt[factor_met_dt$isotope == "M0",]
        all_formulas <- strsplit(m0s_dt$neutral_formula, " / ")
        matched_f <- sapply(unique(unlist(all_formulas)), function(neu_f){
            
            which(sapply(neut_f_list, function(neu_f_feat){
                
                any(sapply(neu_f_feat, function(f_find){
                    neu_f %in% f_find
                }))
            }))
        })
        same_neutral_info <- lapply(neut_f_list, function(n_formula){
            found_info <- lapply(n_formula, function(neut_f){
                found_formula_ids <- matched_f[[neut_f]]
                
                found_features <- factor_met_dt[found_formula_ids,]
                found_adducts <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(found_features)), function(f_ids){
                    found_formula_f <- strsplit(found_features$neutral_formula[f_ids],
                                                " / ")[[1]] == neut_f
                    strsplit(found_features$adduct_annotation[f_ids],
                            " / ")[[1]][found_formula_f]
                })
                
                data.frame("hermes_same_formula_ids" = paste(rownames(found_features),
                                                    collapse = ";"),
                           "hermes_same_formula_num" = nrow(found_features),
                           "hermes_same_formula_adducts" = paste(found_adducts, 
                                                        collapse = ";"),
                           "hermes_same_formula_rt" = paste(round(found_features$rtmed, 2),
                                                    collapse = ";"))
                    
            })
            found_info <- do.call(rbind, found_info)
            found_info <- as.data.frame(lapply(found_info, paste, collapse = " / "))
            found_info
        })
        same_neutral_info <- do.call(rbind, same_neutral_info)
        
        same_f_ids <- strsplit(same_neutral_info$hermes_same_formula_ids, " / ")
        same_f_num <- strsplit(same_neutral_info$hermes_same_formula_num, " / ")
        same_f_add <- strsplit(same_neutral_info$hermes_same_formula_adducts, " / ")
        same_f_rt <- strsplit(same_neutral_info$hermes_same_formula_rt, " / ")
        
        multiple_annotations_hermes <- sapply(factor_met_dt$hermes_same_formula_num, 
                                            function(x){
            neutral_formulas <- strsplit(x, " / ")[[1]]
            max(as.numeric(neutral_formulas))
        }) 
        
        # Filtering no-kegg annotations
        hermes_ann_filt <- lapply(seq_along(kegg_vect_list), function(x){
            kegg_vect <- strsplit(kegg_vect_list[[x]], ";")
            met_vect <- strsplit(met_name_list[[x]], ";")
            filt_kegg_vect <- sapply(kegg_vect, function(kegg_ids){
                if(all(is.na(kegg_ids)) || !length(kegg_ids) || all(kegg_ids == "NA")){return(NA)}
                return(paste(kegg_ids[kegg_ids != "NA"], collapse = ";"))
            })
            filt_met_vect <- sapply(met_vect, function(met_ids){
                if(all(is.na(met_ids)) || !length(met_ids) || all(met_ids == "NA")){return(NA)}
                return(paste(met_ids[met_ids != "NA"], collapse = ";"))
            })
            
            keep_formulas <- !is.na(filt_kegg_vect)
            
            if(all(!keep_formulas)){
                empty_ann <- data.frame("hermes_kegg_ids" = NA,
                    "hermes_formula" = NA,
                    "hermes_adduct" = NA,
                    "hermes_ppm_error" = NA,
                    "hermes_met_id" = NA,
                    "hermes_iso_fidelity" = NA,
                    "hermes_iso_num" = NA,
                    "hermes_proton" = NA,
                    "hermes_same_f_ids" = NA,
                    "hermes_same_f_num" = NA,
                    "hermes_same_f_add" = NA,
                    "hermes_same_f_rt" = NA)
                return(empty_ann)
            }
            
            hermes_formula <- neut_f_list[[x]][keep_formulas]
            hermes_kegg_filt <- filt_kegg_vect[keep_formulas]
            hermes_adduct <- adduct_met_list[[x]][keep_formulas]
            hermes_met_filt <- filt_met_vect[keep_formulas]
            hermes_iso_filt <- iso_fi_list[[x]][keep_formulas]
            hermes_iso_num <- iso_num_list[[x]][keep_formulas]
            hermes_ppm_error <- ppm_errors[[x]][keep_formulas]
            
            hermes_same_f_ids <- same_f_ids[[x]][keep_formulas]
            hermes_same_f_num <- same_f_num[[x]][keep_formulas]
            hermes_same_f_add <- same_f_add[[x]][keep_formulas]
            hermes_same_f_rt <- same_f_rt[[x]][keep_formulas]
            
            h_order <- order(hermes_adduct == "M+H" | hermes_adduct == "M-H",
                            as.numeric(hermes_same_f_num),
                            as.numeric(hermes_iso_num), 
                            as.numeric(hermes_iso_filt),
                            as.numeric(hermes_ppm_error),
                            decreasing = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE)) 
            
            ann_dt <- data.frame("hermes_kegg_ids" = paste(hermes_kegg_filt[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_formula" = paste0(hermes_formula[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_adduct" = paste0(hermes_adduct[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_ppm_error" = paste0(hermes_ppm_error[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_met_id" = paste(hermes_met_filt[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_iso_fidelity" = paste(hermes_iso_filt[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_iso_num" = paste(hermes_iso_num[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_proton" = any(hermes_adduct %in% c("M+H", "M-H")),
                    "hermes_same_f_ids" = paste(hermes_same_f_ids[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_same_f_num" = paste(hermes_same_f_num[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_same_f_add" = paste(hermes_same_f_add[h_order], collapse = " / "),
                    "hermes_same_f_rt" = paste(hermes_same_f_rt[h_order], collapse = " / "))
            return(ann_dt)    
        })
        hermes_ann_filt <- do.call(rbind, hermes_ann_filt)
        
        # Mummichog annotation
        mummichog_kegg_ids <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$compounds, " / ")
        
        mummichog_kegg_names <- lapply(mummichog_kegg_ids, function(kegg_ids_list){
            split_keggs <- strsplit(kegg_ids_list, ";")
            found_kegg <- sapply(split_keggs, function(x){
                kegg_names <- compound_id_2_name[as.character(x)]
                paste(kegg_names, collapse = ";")})
            found_kegg
        })
        
        mummichog_kegg_names[lengths(mummichog_kegg_names) == 0 | mummichog_kegg_names == "NA"] <- NA
        
        mummichog_found_adduct <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$mummichog_adduct_found, " / ")
        str_row_ion <- strsplit(factor_met_dt$str_row_ion, " / ")
        
        # Mummichog ppm errors
        mummichog_ppm_error <- sapply(seq_along(mummichog_found_adduct), function(row_id){
            adduct_mz <- mummichog_adduct_mz[mummichog_found_adduct[[row_id]]]
            
            met_keggs <- strsplit(mummichog_kegg_ids[[row_id]], ";")
            if(all(is.na(met_keggs))){return(NA)}
            kegg_mz <- sapply(met_keggs, function(x){
                found_id <- compound_id_2_mz[x] 
                median(unique(found_id[!is.na(found_id)]))
                
            })
            multiplicity <- ifelse(grepl("\\[.*\\+\\]$", names(adduct_mz)),
                               as.numeric(gsub("^.*\\[|[\\+]\\]$", "", names(adduct_mz))),
                               1)
            
            ionic_f <- (kegg_mz/multiplicity) + adduct_mz
            if(length(kegg_mz) != length(adduct_mz)){
                print(row_id)
                print("Something bad happened!")}
            
            ppm_error_m <- abs(((ionic_f - factor_met_dt$mzmed[row_id])/factor_met_dt$mzmed[row_id])*1e6)
            ppm_error_m[as.numeric(ppm_error_m) > 10] <- NA
            
            
            round(ppm_error_m, 3)
        })
        
        # Mummichog annotations filter
        mummi_ann_list <- lapply(seq_along(mummichog_kegg_ids), function(row_id){
            kegg_vect_ids <- mummichog_kegg_ids[[row_id]]
            kegg_names <- mummichog_kegg_names[[row_id]]
            found_adduct <- mummichog_found_adduct[[row_id]]
            row_ion_adducts <- str_row_ion[[row_id]]
            ppm_error <- mummichog_ppm_error[[row_id]]
            
            num_other_adducts <- lengths(strsplit(row_ion_adducts, ";"))
            
            if(length(kegg_vect_ids) != length(kegg_names)){browser()}
            
            filt_kegg_ids <- lapply(seq_along(kegg_vect_ids), function(list_id){
    
                kegg_ids <- kegg_vect_ids[[list_id]]
                if(all(is.na(kegg_ids)) || !length(kegg_ids) || all(kegg_ids == "NA")){return(data.frame("mummichog_kegg_ids" = NA,
                                      "mummichog_met_names" = NA))}
                
                met_name <- kegg_names[[list_id]] 
                met_name <- gsub("@", "", met_name)
                keep_cp <- !grepl("^CE", kegg_ids) & grepl("^C", kegg_ids) & 
                    !is.na(kegg_ids) & kegg_ids != "NA"
                if(!all(keep_cp)){
                    return(data.frame("mummichog_kegg_ids" = NA,
                                      "mummichog_met_names" = NA))
                }
                num_other_adducts <- length(strsplit(row_ion_adducts, ";")[[1]])
                mummi_dt <- data.frame("mummichog_kegg_ids" = paste(kegg_ids[keep_cp],
                                                                    collapse = ";"),
                                        "mummichog_met_names" = paste(met_name[keep_cp],
                                                         collapse = ";"))
                return(mummi_dt)
            })
            filt_kegg_ids <- do.call(rbind, filt_kegg_ids)
            keep_ids <- !is.na(filt_kegg_ids$mummichog_kegg_ids)
            
            if(all(!keep_ids)){
                mummi_ann <- data.frame("mummichog_kegg_ids" = NA,
                       "mummichog_met_names" = NA,
                       "mummichog_other_adducts" = NA,
                       "mummichog_adduct_found" = NA,
                       "mummichog_ppm_error" = NA,
                       "mummichog_other_adducts_num" = NA,
                       "mummichog_proton" = NA)
                return(mummi_ann)
            }
            
            mummichog_filt_kegg_ids <- filt_kegg_ids$mummichog_kegg_ids[keep_ids]
            mummichog_met_names <- filt_kegg_ids$mummichog_met_names[keep_ids]
            mummichog_other_adducts <- row_ion_adducts[keep_ids]
            mummichog_ppm <- ppm_error[keep_ids]
            mummichog_adduct <- found_adduct[keep_ids]
            mummichog_num_adducts <- num_other_adducts[keep_ids]
            
            m_order <- order(mummichog_adduct == "M+H[1+]" | mummichog_adduct == "M-H[-]",
                            as.numeric(mummichog_num_adducts), 
                            as.numeric(mummichog_ppm),
                            decreasing = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE)) 
            
            mummi_ann <- data.frame("mummichog_kegg_ids" = paste(mummichog_filt_kegg_ids[m_order], 
                                                    collapse = " / "),
                       "mummichog_met_names" = paste(mummichog_met_names[m_order], 
                                                    collapse = " / "),
                       "mummichog_other_adducts" = paste(mummichog_other_adducts[m_order], 
                                                    collapse = " / "),
                       "mummichog_adduct_found" = paste(mummichog_adduct[m_order], 
                                                    collapse = " / "),
                       "mummichog_ppm_error" = paste(mummichog_ppm[m_order], 
                                                    collapse = " / "),
                       "mummichog_other_adducts_num" = paste(mummichog_num_adducts[m_order], 
                                                    collapse = " / "),
                       "mummichog_proton" = any(mummichog_adduct  %in% 
                            c("M+H[1+]", "M-H[-]")))
            return(mummi_ann)
        })
        mummi_ann_list <- do.call(rbind, mummi_ann_list)
    
        merged_results <- cbind(factor_met_dt[,c("mzmed", "rtmin", "rtmax")], 
                                hermes_ann_filt, mummi_ann_list)
        found_hermes <- !is.na(merged_results$hermes_kegg_ids)
        found_mummi <- !is.na(merged_results$mummichog_kegg_ids) 
        ann_order <- order(found_hermes & found_mummi, 
                        found_hermes & found_mummi & 
                            (merged_results$mummichog_proton | 
                                 merged_results$hermes_proton),
                        found_mummi, merged_results$mummichog_proton,
                        found_hermes, merged_results$hermes_proton,
                        decreasing = TRUE)
        
        return(merged_results[ann_order,])
    })
    saveRDS(factor_rd_list_filt, metabolite_ordered_kegg_dt_path)
} else{
    factor_rd_list_filt <- readRDS(metabolite_ordered_kegg_dt_path)
}

factor_rd_list_filt <- lapply(factor_rd_list_filt, function(factor_rd){
    m_mets_list <- strsplit(factor_rd$mummichog_met_names, ";| / ")
    h_mets_list <- strsplit(factor_rd$hermes_met_id, ";| / ")
    
    merged_mets <- mapply(function(m_mets, h_mets){
       merged_ids <- union(m_mets, h_mets) 
       merged_ids[!is.na(merged_ids) & merged_ids != "NA"]
    }, m_mets = m_mets_list, h_mets = h_mets_list)
    merged_mets <- sapply(merged_mets, paste, collapse = " / ")
    merged_mets[merged_mets == ""] <- rownames(factor_rd)[merged_mets == ""]
    factor_rd$merged_names <- merged_mets
    
    merged_names_readable <- stringr::str_trunc(merged_mets, width = 75)
    merged_names_readable <- gsub(";|\\$", " / ", merged_names_readable)
    # row_dt_names <- gsub(" / |/  |  /|/", " / ", row_dt_names)
    merged_names_readable <- strsplit(merged_names_readable, " / ")
    
    merged_names_readable <- sapply(merged_names_readable, function(x){
        x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "NA"]
        if(any(grepl("\\.\\.\\.", x))){
            return(paste0(paste0(x[1:(length(x)-1)], collapse = " / "), " / ..."))    
        } else{
            return(paste(x, collapse = " / "))
        }    
    })
    factor_rd$merged_names_readable <- merged_names_readable
    factor_rd
})

output_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

lapply(names(factor_rd_list_filt), function(factor_id){
    factor_rd <- factor_rd_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    sheet_name <- paste0("All_Metabolites.", factor_id)
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = output_wb, 
                        sheetName = sheet_name)       
    openxlsx::writeData(wb = output_wb, sheet = sheet_name, 
                x = factor_rd, rowNames = TRUE)
})

openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb = output_wb,  overwrite = TRUE,
                    file = paste0(mofa_metab_path, "Factor_Metabolite_List_Ordered.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
targ_cor_res_dt_full <- lapply(experiments(targ_met_dt_full), function(exp_dt){
    exp_dt <- t(assay(exp_dt))
    intersect_samp <- intersect(rownames(exp_dt), rownames(mofa_factors_dt))
    cor(mofa_factors_dt[intersect_samp,], exp_dt[intersect_samp,])
})

targ_cor_res_dt_75_full <- lapply(targ_cor_res_dt_full, function(cor_dt){
    cor_factor <- apply(cor_dt, 2, function(x){
        cor_sel <- which(abs(x)/sum(abs(x)) > 0.75)
        
        # if(!length(cor_sel)){
        #     cor_sel <- intersect(which(abs(x) > 0.5), which.max(abs(x)))
        #     if(!length(cor_sel)){return(0)}
        # }
        return(cor_sel)
    })
    factor_res <- lapply(c(1, 2), function(f_id){
        names(cor_factor[cor_factor == f_id])
    })
    names(factor_res) <- c("Factor 1", "Factor 2")
    factor_res
})

targ_cor_res_dt_full <- lapply(experiments(targ_met_dt_full), function(exp_dt){
    exp_dt <- t(assay(exp_dt))
    intersect_samp <- intersect(rownames(exp_dt), rownames(mofa_factors_dt))
    factor_dt_ord <- mofa_factors_dt[intersect_samp,]
    exp_dt <- exp_dt[intersect_samp,]

    factor_res <- lapply(colnames(factor_dt_ord), function(factor_id){
        exp_res <- lapply(colnames(exp_dt), function(var_id){
            test_res <- as.data.frame(cor.test(factor_dt_ord[,factor_id],
                                               exp_dt[,var_id])[1:4])
            test_res$factor <- factor_id
            test_res$variable_id <- var_id
            test_res
        })
        do.call(rbind, exp_res)
    })
    names(factor_res) <- colnames(factor_dt_ord)
    factor_res <- do.call(rbind, factor_res)
    factor_res$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(factor_res$p.value, "fdr")
    factor_res
})

targ_cor_res_dt_full_filt <- lapply(targ_cor_res_dt_full, function(organ_dt){
    organ_dt[abs(round(organ_dt$estimate, 2)) >= 0.75 & organ_dt$adj.p.value <= 0.05,]
})

targ_cor_res_dt_full_sig <- lapply(targ_cor_res_dt_full, function(organ_dt){
    organ_dt[organ_dt$adj.p.value <= 0.05,]
})
```

```{r}
for(x in seq_along(kegg_db_list_dt)){

        pathway_dist_filt[x, y] <- length(intersect(kegg_db_list_dt[[x]],
                                                kegg_db_list_dt[[y]]))/length(union(kegg_db_list_dt[[x]], kegg_db_list_dt[[y]]))    
    }

readable_var_names <- sapply(names(omic_var_dict), function(var_name){
    var_omic <- omic_var_dict[var_name]
    var_col <- variables_dicts[[var_omic]]
    
    var_dt <- rowData(omic_dt[[var_omic]])[var_name,]
    if(is.na(var_col)){
        return(rownames(var_dt))
    } else{
        var_name_found <- var_dt[[var_col]]
        if(is.na(var_name_found)){return(rownames(var_dt))}
        return(var_name_found)
    }
})

microb_reg_var_2_kegg_dict <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    enrich_res <- met_gene_microb_enrich_results[[factor_id]]
    enrich_res <- as.data.frame(enrich_res[["All Weights"]])
    var_ids_list <- strsplit(enrich_res$geneID, "/") 
    unique_vars <- unique(unlist(var_ids_list))
    var_2_kegg <- lapply(unique_vars, function(var_id){
        found_var <- sapply(var_ids_list, function(kegg_vars){any(kegg_vars %in% var_id)})
        filtered_desc <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "",
                            enrich_res$Description)
        filtered_desc[found_var]
    })
    names(var_2_kegg) <- unique_vars
    var_2_kegg
})
```

### Species - Genes KEGG microbreg correlations

```{r}
### Correlations
entrez_to_ensembl <- rownames(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])
names(entrez_to_ensembl) <- as.character(rowData(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$entrezID)

factor_plot_correlations <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    
    enrich_genes <- strsplit(as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_microb[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$geneID, "/")
    names(enrich_genes) <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", 
                                as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_microb[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description)
    
    enrich_genes <- lapply(enrich_genes, function(x){
        entrez_to_ensembl[as.character(x)]
    })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- genus_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = row_dt$Var1, "Var2" = kegg_pathways, "cor" = row_dt$cor)
    })
    do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
})
```

### Species - Genes + Metabolites

```{r}
genus_unt_dt <- omic_dt[,,grep("Untargeted|Shotgun.*Genus", names(omic_dt))]
genus_unt_dt <- genus_unt_dt[,intersect(colnames(genus_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]),
                          colnames(genus_unt_dt[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]]))]
assayNames(genus_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]) <- "dt1"
assayNames(genus_unt_dt[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]]) <- "dt1"

genus_unt_corr_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    
    var_exp <- genus_unt_dt[rownames(genus_unt_dt) %in% 
                                names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]),]
    if(any(lengths(var_exp) == 0)){return(NULL)}
    
    mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(var_exp, test_significance = TRUE, 
                                        method = "pearson", 
                                        assay_name = "dt1",
                                        assay_name2 = "dt1")
})
names(genus_unt_corr_list) <- factor_ids
genus_unt_corr_list[sapply(genus_unt_corr_list, is.null)] <- NULL

genus_unt_rna_corr_list <- lapply(names(genus_unt_corr_list), function(factor_id){
    corr_merge <- rbind(genus_unt_corr_list[[factor_id]], genus_rna_corr_list[[factor_id]])
    corr_merge$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_merge$pval, method = "fdr")
    corr_merge
})
names(genus_unt_rna_corr_list) <- names(genus_unt_corr_list)
genus_unt_rna_corr_list_filt <- lapply(genus_unt_rna_corr_list, function(corr_dt){
    corr_dt[abs(corr_dt$cor) >= 0.8 & corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
})
```

```{r}
correlations_wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(correlations_wb, sheetName = "f1_genus_met_genes")
addWorksheet(correlations_wb, sheetName = "f2_genus_met_genes")
writeData(correlations_wb, sheet = "f1_genus_met_genes",
        genus_unt_rna_corr_list[["Factor_1"]][genus_unt_rna_corr_list[["Factor_1"]]$p_adj <= 0.05,], row.names = TRUE)
writeData(correlations_wb, sheet = "f2_genus_met_genes",
        genus_unt_rna_corr_list[["Factor_2"]][genus_unt_rna_corr_list[["Factor_2"]]$p_adj <= 0.05,], row.names = TRUE)

saveWorkbook(correlations_wb, file = paste0(corr_output_dir,
                                            "genus_met_genes_sig_correlations.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
    # })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- fa_unt_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    
    # test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    # 
    test_genes_df$orig_Var1 <- test_genes_df$Var1
    test_genes_df$orig_Var2 <- test_genes_df$Var2
    
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- cog_dict_fa[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    
    
    # test_genes_df$Var2 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var2)]
    test_genes_df <- test_genes_df[test_genes_df$Var1 != "",]
    
    
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = gsub("Colon ", "", row_dt$Var1), 
                    "Var2" = kegg_pathways, "cor" = row_dt$cor,
                   "pval" = row_dt$pval, "p_adj" = row_dt$p_adj,
                   "orig_Var1" = row_dt$orig_Var1,
                   "orig_Var2" = row_dt$orig_Var2)
    })
    do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
})
names(factor_plot_correlations_fgm) <- factor_ids
```

```{r}
test_sankey <- sankey_merged_correlations_2$Factor_2

test_sankey_corrs <- sankey_merged_correlations$Factor_2

# test_sankey$source %in% test_sankey$target

test_sankey <- t(as.matrix(table(test_sankey$source, test_sankey$target)))

class(test_sankey) <- "matrix"

links <- test_sankey %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var="source") %>% 
    gather(key="target", value="value", -1) %>%
    filter(value != 0)

## Link colors
links_num_corrs <- apply(links, 1, function(x){
    found_corrs <- test_sankey_corrs[test_sankey_corrs$target == x[1] & 
                                        test_sankey_corrs$source == x[2],]
    cor_factor <- factor(ifelse(found_corrs$cor < 0, "Negative", "Positive"), 
                        levels = c("Negative", "Positive"),
                        labels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
    prop.table(table(cor_factor))["Positive"]
})

color_ramp <- colorRampPalette(c("#01665e", "#ffffbf","#8c510A"))
color_list <- paste0(color_ramp(10), "33")
links_num_corrs_cut <- cut(links_num_corrs, breaks = seq(0,1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)
names(color_list) <- levels(links_num_corrs_cut)

links_colors <- color_list[as.character(links_num_corrs_cut)]

# From these flows we need to create a node data frame: it lists every entities involved in the flow
nodes <- data.frame(
    name=c(as.character(links$source), as.character(links$target)) %>% 
        unique()
)

nodes$color_group <- node_color_fc_palette[as.character(nodes$name)]

names(sort(table(factor_plot_correlations_fgm$Factor_2$Var1), decreasing = TRUE)), 
names(sort(table(factor_plot_correlations_fgenus$Factor_2$Var1))),
names(sort(table(factor_plot_correlations_fgm$Factor_2$Var2), decreasing = TRUE)))

ordered_links <- links[order(links_num_corrs, decreasing = TRUE),]

# node_ordered2 <- unique(c(ordered_links$source, ordered_links$target))

# nodes$name <- node_ordered2

node_ordered <- node_ordered[node_ordered %in% nodes$name]
node_ordered <- node_ordered[!duplicated(node_ordered)]
nodes$name <- node_ordered

node_color_fc_palette <- node_color_fc_palette[names(node_color_fc_palette) %in% nodes$name]

nodes$color_group <- node_color_fc_palette[as.character(nodes$name)]
# full_merged_dict <- c(cog_colors_fa, kegg_colors, genus_color_dict)
# full_merged_dict <- c(cog_colors_fa_fc, kegg_colors_fc, genus_color_dict)

# names(full_merged_dict_found_hex) <- names(full_merged_dict_found)

# With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
links$color <- names(links_colors)


# my_color <- paste0('d3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["', 
#                     paste0(c(names(color_list), 
#                             names(full_merged_dict_found_hex)), collapse = '" , "'), 
#                     '"]) .range(["',

# names(node_color_fc_palette_fix) <- make.names(names(node_color_fc_palette_fix))

my_color <- paste0('d3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["', 
                    paste0(c(names(color_list), 
                            names(node_color_list)), collapse = '" , "'), 
                    '"]) .range(["', 
                    paste0(c(color_list, node_color_list), collapse = '" , "'),'"])')

# my_color <- paste0('d3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["',

#                     '"]) .range(["', 
#                     paste0(c(full_merged_dict_found_hex), collapse = '" , "'),'"])')


# Make the Network
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
                    Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
                    Value = "value", NodeID = "name", colourScale = my_color,
                    iterations = 0,fontSize = 12,fontFamily = "arial",
                    NodeGroup = "color_group", sinksRight=FALSE, LinkGroup = "color")

p
```

### Metals + Genes KEGG DMRreg

```{r}
metal_rna_dt <- omic_dt[,,grep("RNA_Seq|Metallomics.liver", names(omic_dt))]
metal_rna_dt <- metal_rna_dt[,intersect(colnames(metal_rna_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]),
                          colnames(metal_rna_dt[["Metallomics.liver"]]))]
assayNames(metal_rna_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]) <- "dt1"
assayNames(metal_rna_dt[["Metallomics.liver"]]) <- "dt1"

metal_rna_corr_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    var_exp <- metal_rna_dt[rownames(metal_rna_dt) %in% 
                                names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]),]
    if(any(lengths(var_exp) == 0)){return(NULL)}
    
    mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(var_exp, test_significance = TRUE, 
                                        method = "pearson", 
                                        assay_name = "dt1",
                                        assay_name2 = "dt1")
})
names(metal_rna_corr_list) <- factor_ids
metal_rna_corr_list[sapply(metal_rna_corr_list, is.null)] <- NULL

metal_rna_corr_list_filt <- lapply(metal_rna_corr_list, function(corr_dt){
    corr_dt[abs(corr_dt$cor) >= 0.75 & corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
})

```



```{r}
### Correlations
entrez_to_ensembl <- rownames(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])
names(entrez_to_ensembl) <- as.character(rowData(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$entrezID)

factor_plot_correlations <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    
    enrich_genes <- strsplit(as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_dmrreg[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$geneID, "/")
    names(enrich_genes) <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", 
                                as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_dmrreg[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description)
    
    enrich_genes <- lapply(enrich_genes, function(x){
        entrez_to_ensembl[as.character(x)]
    })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- metal_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = row_dt$Var1, "Var2" = kegg_pathways, "cor" = row_dt$cor)
    })
    do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
})
names(factor_plot_correlations) <- factor_ids

### metal colors

metal_color_dict <- var_color_vector[grepl("Metal", omic_var_dict)]
names(metal_color_dict) <- readable_var_names[as.character(names(metal_color_dict))]

var_color_merge <- c(metal_color_dict, kegg_colors)

### Correlations colors
factor_corr_colors <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    test_genes_df <- factor_plot_correlations[[factor_id]]
    ifelse(test_genes_df$cor > 0, paired_palette[3], paired_palette[1])
})
names(factor_corr_colors) <- factor_ids


test <- factor_plot_correlations$Factor_1[,c("Var1", "Var2")]
corr_colors <- factor_corr_colors$Factor_1


svg(paste0(fig_dir, "Supp_Figure_Factor_1_pearson_metal_rna_kegg_gbd.svg"), 
    width = 30, height = 30)
circos.par$circle.margin = c(2, 2, 2, 2)

chordDiagram(test, annotationTrack = "grid", 
            order = rev(names(var_color_merge)), 
            grid.col = var_color_merge, 
            col = corr_colors, small.gap = 6,
            preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = max(strwidth(unlist(dimnames(test))))))

circos.track(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
        circos.text(CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1], 
                    # labels = stringr::str_wrap(CELL_META$sector.index, 
                                                # width = 40),                        
            labels = CELL_META$sector.index,
            facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE, cex = 3,  
            adj = c(0, 0.5))
    }, bg.border = NA)
dev.off()
```

### Cobalt + Genes + Metabolites KEGG DMRreg + Genus + FA

```{r}
selected_omics_2 <- grepl("Untargeted|Metallomics.liver|RNA|Shotgun.*Genus|Shotgun.*cogs", 
                         names(f2_multi_omics))

colnames(f2_multi_omics[["Metallomics.liver"]])

f2_multi_omics_filt <- f2_multi_omics[,,selected_omics_2]
experiments(f2_multi_omics_filt) <- ExperimentList(lapply(experiments(f2_multi_omics_filt), function(exp_dt){
    assayNames(exp_dt) <- "dt1"
    exp_dt
}))

cobalt_corr_res <- lapply(names(f2_multi_omics_filt), function(dt_id){
    omic_exp <- f2_multi_omics_filt[,,c("Metallomics.liver",dt_id)] 
    if(dt_id == "Metallomics.liver"){return(NA)}
    overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(omic_exp[[1]]), 
                                colnames(omic_exp[[2]]))
    
    corr_res <- mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(omic_exp[,overlap_samples,],
                                        test_significance = TRUE, 
                                        method = "pearson",
                                        assay_name = "dt1",
                                        assay_name2 = "dt1",
                                        p_adj_method = "fdr")
    corr_res$omic_id <- dt_id
    corr_res
})
names(cobalt_corr_res) <- names(f2_multi_omics_filt)

cobalt_corr_res[is.na(cobalt_corr_res)] <- NULL
cobalt_corr_res <- do.call(rbind, cobalt_corr_res)

cobalt_corr_res$p_adj <- p.adjust(cobalt_corr_res$pval, "fdr")
cobalt_corr_plot_sig <- cobalt_corr_res[abs(cobalt_corr_res$cor) > 0.75 & 
                                            cobalt_corr_res$p_adj <= 0.05,]
```


```{r}
correlations_wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(correlations_wb, sheetName = "cobalt_corr")
writeData(correlations_wb, sheet = "cobalt_corr",
        cobalt_corr_res, row.names = FALSE)

saveWorkbook(correlations_wb, file = paste0(corr_output_dir,
                                            "cobalt_sig_correlations.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cobalt_corr_pw <- microb_reg_var_2_kegg_dict$Factor_2[as.character(cobalt_corr_plot_sig$Var2)]
names(cobalt_corr_pw) <- as.character(cobalt_corr_plot_sig$Var2)

cog_found <- names(cobalt_corr_pw) %in% names(cog_dict_fa)
cobalt_corr_pw[cog_found] <- cog_dict_fa[names(cobalt_corr_pw)[cog_found]]
cobalt_corr_pw[cobalt_corr_pw == ""] <- list(NULL)

cobalt_corr_pw[grepl("Genus:", names(cobalt_corr_pw))] <- grep("Genus:", names(cobalt_corr_pw), value = TRUE)

##### Preparing plot data 1 with functional pathways
cobalt_corr_plot_copy <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cobalt_corr_plot_sig)), function(row_id){
    pw_found <- cobalt_corr_pw[[row_id]]
    cobalt_corr_copy <- cobalt_corr_plot_sig[rep(row_id, length(pw_found)),]
    cobalt_corr_copy$readable_var_name <- pw_found
    cobalt_corr_copy
})
cobalt_corr_plot_copy <- do.call(rbind, cobalt_corr_plot_copy)
```

```{r}
### Var_colors
var_unique <- c(as.character(unique(cobalt_corr_plot_copy$Var1)),
                as.character(unique(cobalt_corr_plot_copy$readable_var_name)))

cobalt_color_dict <- var_color_vector[names(var_color_vector) %in% var_unique]

### Kegg colors fc
cobalt_kegg_ids <- !as.character(cobalt_corr_plot_copy$Var2) %in% names(cobalt_color_dict)

kegg_fc <- var_fc_dict[as.character(cobalt_corr_plot_copy$Var2[cobalt_kegg_ids])]

kegg_fc_prc <- tapply(kegg_fc, cobalt_corr_plot_copy$readable_var_name[cobalt_kegg_ids], function(x){
```

```{r}
dmr_2_symbol_reg <- paste(rowData(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])$geneSymbol,
                          simplified_DMR_annotation[as.character(rownames(rowData(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])))])

selected_omics_2 <- grepl("Untargeted|Metallomics.liver|RNA|Shotgun.*Genus|Shotgun.*cogs", 
                         names(f2_multi_omics))

colnames(f2_multi_omics[["Metallomics.liver"]])

f2_multi_omics_filt_hfe <- f2_multi_omics[f2int_f2hde_overlapping,,selected_omics_2]

experiments(f2_multi_omics_filt_hfe) <- ExperimentList(lapply(experiments(f2_multi_omics_filt_hfe), function(exp_dt){
    assayNames(exp_dt) <- "dt1"
    exp_dt
}))

omic_1_ids <- names(f2_multi_omics)[grepl("Metallomics|Shotgun.*Genus", 
                    names(f2_multi_omics))]

hfd_ex_corr_res <- lapply(names(f2_multi_omics_filt_hfe), function(dt_id){
    if(dt_id %in% omic_1_ids){return(NA)}
    corr_res_list <- lapply(omic_1_ids, function(omic_id){
            
        omic_exp <- f2_multi_omics_filt_hfe[,,c(omic_id,dt_id)] 
        
        overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(omic_exp[[1]]), 
                                    colnames(omic_exp[[2]]))
        
        corr_res <- mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(omic_exp[,overlap_samples,],
                                            test_significance = TRUE, 
                                            method = "pearson",
                                            assay_name = "dt1",
                                            assay_name2 = "dt1",
                                            p_adj_method = "fdr")
        corr_res$omic_id <- dt_id
        corr_res$omic_id_2 <- omic_id
        corr_res
    })
    
    do.call(rbind, corr_res_list)
})
names(hfd_ex_corr_res) <- names(f2_multi_omics_filt)

hfd_ex_corr_res[is.na(hfd_ex_corr_res)] <- NULL

hfd_ex_corr_plot_sig <- hfd_ex_corr_res[abs(hfd_ex_corr_res$cor) > 0.75 & 
                                            hfd_ex_corr_res$p_adj <= 0.05,]
```

```{r}
microb_reg_var_2_kegg_dict_hfd_ex <- lapply("F2_INT_F2_HFE", function(factor_id){

    var_ids_list <- strsplit(enrich_res$geneID, "/") 
    unique_vars <- unique(unlist(var_ids_list))
    var_2_kegg <- lapply(unique_vars, function(var_id){

                            enrich_res$Description)
        filtered_desc[found_var]
    })
    names(var_2_kegg) <- unique_vars
    var_2_kegg
})
```

### Metals + Genes + Metabolites KEGG DMRreg

```{r}
metal_unt_dt <- omic_dt[,,grep("Untargeted|Metallomics.liver", names(omic_dt))]
metal_unt_dt <- metal_unt_dt[,intersect(colnames(metal_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]),
                          colnames(metal_unt_dt[["Metallomics.liver"]]))]
assayNames(metal_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]) <- "dt1"
assayNames(metal_unt_dt[["Metallomics.liver"]]) <- "dt1"

metal_unt_corr_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    
    var_exp <- metal_unt_dt[rownames(metal_unt_dt) %in% 
                                names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]),]
    if(any(lengths(var_exp) == 0)){return(NULL)}
    
    mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(var_exp, test_significance = TRUE, 
                                        method = "pearson", 
                                        assay_name = "dt1",
                                        assay_name2 = "dt1")
})
names(metal_unt_corr_list) <- factor_ids
metal_unt_corr_list[sapply(metal_unt_corr_list, is.null)] <- NULL

metal_unt_rna_corr_list <- lapply(names(metal_unt_corr_list), function(factor_id){
    corr_merge <- rbind(metal_unt_corr_list[[factor_id]], metal_rna_corr_list[[factor_id]])
    corr_merge$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_merge$pval, method = "fdr")
    corr_merge
})
names(metal_unt_rna_corr_list) <- names(metal_unt_corr_list)
metal_unt_rna_corr_list_filt <- lapply(metal_unt_rna_corr_list, function(corr_dt){
    corr_dt[abs(corr_dt$cor) >= 0.75 & corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
})

```



```{r}
### Correlations
entrez_to_ensembl <- rownames(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])
names(entrez_to_ensembl) <- as.character(rowData(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$entrezID)

factor_plot_correlations <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    enrich_genes <- strsplit(as.data.frame(met_gene_dmrreg_enrich_results[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$geneID, "/")
    names(enrich_genes) <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", 
                                as.data.frame(met_gene_dmrreg_enrich_results[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description)
    
    # enrich_genes <- lapply(enrich_genes, function(x){
    #     entrez_to_ensembl[as.character(x)]
    # })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- metal_unt_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = row_dt$Var1, "Var2" = kegg_pathways, 
                   "cor" = row_dt$cor, "old_var" = row_dt$Var2)
    })
    do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
})
names(factor_plot_correlations) <- factor_ids

### metal colors

metal_color_dict <- var_color_vector[grepl("Metal", omic_var_dict)]

})

kegg_fc_cut <- cut(kegg_fc_prc, 
                      breaks = seq(0,1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)
names(node_color_list) <- levels(kegg_fc_cut)

kegg_fc_perc <- node_color_list[as.character(kegg_fc_cut)]
names(kegg_fc_perc) <- names(kegg_fc_prc)

var_color_merge <- c(metal_color_dict, kegg_fc_perc)

### Correlations colors

    test_genes_df <- factor_plot_correlations[[factor_id]]

})
```

```{r}
                                as.data.frame(met_gene_dmrreg_enrich_results[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description)
    
    # enrich_genes <- lapply(enrich_genes, function(x){
    #     entrez_to_ensembl[as.character(x)]
    # })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- histone_unt_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = row_dt$Var1, 
                    "Var2" = kegg_pathways, "cor" = row_dt$cor,
                    "old_var2" = row_dt$Var1)
    })
    gene_correlations <- do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
    gene_correlations
})
names(factor_plot_correlations) <- c("Factor_1")

### histone colors
```

### Histone + Genes + Metabolites All F1 KEGG 

```{r}
histone_unt_dt <- omic_dt[,,grep("Untargeted|Histone", names(omic_dt))][,,2:1]
histone_unt_dt <- histone_unt_dt[,intersect(colnames(histone_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]),
                          colnames(histone_unt_dt[["Histone_Modifications_Proteomics"]]))]
assayNames(histone_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]) <- "dt1"
assayNames(histone_unt_dt[["Histone_Modifications_Proteomics"]]) <- "dt1"



histone_unt_corr_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    
    var_exp <- histone_unt_dt[rownames(histone_unt_dt) %in% 
                                names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]),]
    if(any(lengths(var_exp) == 0)){return(NULL)}
    
    mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(var_exp, test_significance = TRUE, 
                                        method = "pearson", 
                                        assay_name = "dt1",
                                        assay_name2 = "dt1")
})
names(histone_unt_corr_list) <- factor_ids
histone_unt_corr_list[sapply(histone_unt_corr_list, is.null)] <- NULL

histone_unt_rna_corr_list <- lapply(names(histone_unt_corr_list), function(factor_id){
    corr_merge <- rbind(histone_unt_corr_list[[factor_id]], histone_rna_corr_list[[factor_id]])
    corr_merge$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_merge$pval, method = "fdr")
    corr_merge
})
names(histone_unt_rna_corr_list) <- names(histone_unt_corr_list)
histone_unt_rna_corr_list_filt <- lapply(histone_unt_rna_corr_list, function(corr_dt){
    corr_dt[abs(corr_dt$cor) >= 0.75 & corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
})
```
